title.zh: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二: 文宗一
title.raw: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二: 文宗一 Volume 32 Annals 32: Wenzong 1

sentences.zh: 文宗聖明元孝皇帝，諱圖帖睦爾，武宗之次子，明宗之弟也。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong, posthumous name Shengming Yuanxiao, taboo name Tugh Temür, was Wuzong's second son and Mingzong's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong, posthumous name Shengming Yuanxiao, taboo name Tugh Temür, was Wuzong's second son and Mingzong's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 母曰文獻昭聖皇后，唐兀氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng of the Tangut clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng of the Tangut clan.

sentences.zh: 大德三年，武宗總兵北邊，帝以八年春正月癸亥生。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dade, Wuzong commanded troops on the northern frontier; the Emperor was born on guihai day in the first month of spring of the eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dade, Wuzong commanded troops on the northern frontier; the Emperor was born on guihai day in the first month of spring of the eighth year.

sentences.zh: 十一年，武宗入繼大統。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Wuzong entered to succeed to the Great Foundation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Wuzong entered to succeed to the Great Foundation.

sentences.zh: 至大四年，武宗崩，傳位於弟仁宗。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida, Wuzong died and passed the throne to his younger brother Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhida, Wuzong died and passed the throne to his younger brother Renzong.

sentences.zh: 延祐三年，丞相鐵木叠兒等議立英宗為皇太子，明宗以武宗長子，乃出之，居於朔漠。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yanyou, Chancellor Tiemudie'er and others deliberated on installing Shidebala as crown prince; because Mingzong was Wuzong's eldest son, he was sent out and resided in the northern desert.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yanyou, Chancellor Tiemudie'er and others deliberated on installing Shidebala as crown prince; because Mingzong was Wuzong's eldest son, he was sent out and resided in the northern desert.

sentences.zh: 及英宗即位，鐵木叠兒復為丞相，懷私固寵，構釁骨肉，諸王大臣，莫不自危。

translations.literal: When Shidebala ascended the throne, Tiemudie'er again became chancellor; cherishing private ends and clinging to favor, he provoked strife among kinsmen, and princes and great ministers all felt themselves imperiled.
translations.idiomatic: When Shidebala ascended the throne, Tiemudie'er again became chancellor; cherishing private ends and clinging to favor, he provoked strife among kinsmen, and princes and great ministers all felt themselves imperiled.

sentences.zh: 至治元年五月，中政使咬住告脫歡察兒等交通親王，於是出帝居於海南。

translations.literal: Fifth month of the first year of Zhizhi, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Yaochu reported that Toghancha'er and others had dealings with princes; thereupon the Emperor was sent out to reside in Hainan.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month of the first year of Zhizhi, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Yaochu reported that Toghancha'er and others had dealings with princes; thereupon the Emperor was sent out to reside in Hainan.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，英宗在上都，謂丞相拜住曰：「朕兄弟實相友愛，曩以小人譖伝，俾居遠方，當亟召還，明正小人離間之罪。

translations.literal: Sixth month of the third year, Shidebala at Shangdu said to Chancellor Baizhu: "We brothers are truly friendly and loving; formerly, because petty men slandered and transmitted false reports, We were made to dwell in a distant place — they should be summoned back at once, and the petty men's crime of sowing discord should be clearly rectified.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month of the third year, Shidebala at Shangdu said to Chancellor Baizhu, "We brothers are truly friendly and loving; formerly, because petty men slandered and transmitted false reports, We were made to dwell in a distant place — they should be summoned back at once, and the petty men's crime of sowing discord should be clearly rectified.

sentences.zh: 」未幾，鐵失、也先鐵木兒等為逆，而晉王遂立為皇帝，改元泰定。

translations.literal: " Before long, Tieshi, Yeshi Temür, and others committed treason; the Prince of Jin thereupon installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long, Tieshi, Yeshi Temür, and others committed treason; the Prince of Jin thereupon installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.

sentences.zh: 召帝於海南之瓊州，還至潭州，復命止之。

translations.literal: The Emperor was summoned from Qiong Prefecture in Hainan; reaching Tan Prefecture, he was again ordered to halt.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was summoned from Qiong Prefecture in Hainan; reaching Tan Prefecture, he was again ordered to halt.

sentences.zh: 居數月，乃還京師。

translations.literal: After several months, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After several months, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十月，封懷王，賜黃金印。

translations.literal: Tenth month, he was enfeoffed Prince of Huai and granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, he was enfeoffed Prince of Huai and granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，又命出居於建康，以殊祥院使也先捏掌其衛士。

translations.literal: First month of the second year, he was again ordered out to reside at Jiankang; Special Sign Office commissioner Yesianier was put in charge of his guard soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: First month of the second year, he was again ordered out to reside at Jiankang; Special Sign Office commissioner Yesianier was put in charge of his guard soldiers.

sentences.zh: 初，晉王既為皇帝，以內史倒剌沙為中書平章政事，遂為丞相，狡愎自用，災異數見，而帝兄弟播越南北，人心思之。

translations.literal: Earlier, after the Prince of Jin had become emperor, he made inner scribe Doresh central secretariat grand councillor, who then became chancellor; crafty and obstinate, acting on his own judgment, calamities and portents repeatedly appeared, while the Emperor and his brother were driven to wander north and south — the hearts of the people turned to them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, after the Prince of Jin had become emperor, he made inner scribe Doresh central secretariat grand councillor, who then became chancellor; crafty and obstinate, acting on his own judgment, calamities and portents repeatedly appeared, while the Emperor and his brother were driven to wander north and south — the hearts of the people turned to them.

sentences.zh: 三月，大駕至上都，滿禿、闊闊出等扈從。

translations.literal: Third month, the imperial procession reached Shangdu; Manu and Kuokochu and others attended as escorts.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, the imperial procession reached Shangdu; Manu and Kuokochu and others attended as escorts.

sentences.zh: 西安王阿剌忒納失裏居守，燕鐵木兒亦留大都。

translations.literal: Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri remained to guard the capital; Yan Temür also remained at Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri remained to guard the capital; Yan Temür also remained at Dadu.

sentences.zh: 時也先捏私至上都，與倒剌沙等圖弗利於帝，乃遣宗正紥魯忽赤雍古臺遷帝居江陵。

translations.literal: At that time Yesianier secretly went to Shangdu and, with Doresh and others, plotted profit against the Emperor; he then dispatched clan prince registrar Zha Ruhu Chi Yonggutai to transfer the Emperor's residence to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yesianier secretly went to Shangdu and, with Doresh and others, plotted profit against the Emperor; he then dispatched clan prince registrar Zha Ruhu Chi Yonggutai to transfer the Emperor's residence to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 七月庚午，泰定皇帝崩於上都。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 倒剌沙及梁王王禪、遼王脫脫，因結黨害政，人皆不平。

translations.literal: Doresh together with Prince of Liang Wang Chan and Prince of Liaoning Toqto formed a faction to harm government; everyone was resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Doresh together with Prince of Liang Wang Chan and Prince of Liaoning Toqto formed a faction to harm government; everyone was resentful.

sentences.zh: 時燕鐵木兒實掌大都樞密符印，謀於西安王阿剌忒納失裏，陰結勇士，以圖舉義。

translations.literal: At that time Yan Temür in fact held the Privy Council tally and seal at Dadu; he consulted Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri and secretly gathered brave men to plot raising righteous action.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yan Temür in fact held the Privy Council tally and seal at Dadu; he consulted Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri and secretly gathered brave men to plot raising righteous action.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，黎明，百官集興聖宮，燕鐵木兒率阿剌鐵木兒、孛倫赤等十七人，兵皆露刃，號於眾曰：「武宗皇帝有聖子二人，孝友仁文，天下正統當歸之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiawu day at dawn, the hundred officials assembled at Xingsheng Palace; Yan Temür led Alaq Temür, Borjichi, and seventeen others — the troops all bared their blades — and proclaimed to the multitude: "The Martial Emperor had two sage sons, filial, brotherly, benevolent, and literary; the correct succession of all under Heaven ought to return to them.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiawu day at dawn, the hundred officials assembled at Xingsheng Palace; Yan Temür led Alaq Temür, Borjichi, and 17 others — the troops all bared their blades — and proclaimed to the multitude, "The Martial Emperor had two sage sons, filial, brotherly, benevolent, and literary; the correct succession of all under Heaven ought to return to them.

sentences.zh: 今爾一二臣，敢紊邦紀，有不順者斬！

translations.literal: Now you one or two ministers dare to disorder the state's regulations — whoever does not obey shall be beheaded!
translations.idiomatic: Now you one or two ministers dare to disorder the state's regulations — whoever does not obey shall be beheaded!

sentences.zh: 」乃手縛平章政事烏伯都剌、伯顏察兒，分命勇士執中書左丞朵朵，參知政事王士熙，參議中書省事脫脫、吳秉道，侍御史鐵木哥、丘世傑，治書侍御史脫歡，太子詹事丞王桓等，皆下之獄。

translations.literal: " Thereupon with his own hand he bound grand councillor Ubaidullah and Barqachar; brave men were separately ordered to seize central secretariat left vice chancellor Duodu, associate administrator Wang Shixi, central secretariat deliberator Toqto, Wu Bingdao, supervising censor Temürge, Qiu Shijie, investigating censor Toqan, crown prince household vice director Wang Huan, and others — all were thrown into prison.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon with his own hand he bound grand councillor Ubaidullah and Barqachar; brave men were separately ordered to seize central secretariat left vice chancellor Duodu, associate administrator Wang Shixi, central secretariat deliberator Toqto, Wu Bingdao, supervising censor Temürge, Qiu Shijie, investigating censor Toqan, crown prince household vice director Wang Huan, and others — all were thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒與西安王阿剌忒納失裏共守內廷，籍府庫，錄符印，召百官入內聽命。

translations.literal: Yan Temür together with Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri jointly guarded the inner court, registered treasury stores, recorded tallies and seals, and summoned the hundred officials into the palace to receive orders.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür together with Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri jointly guarded the inner court, registered treasury stores, recorded tallies and seals, and summoned the hundred officials into the palace to receive orders.

sentences.zh: 即遣前河南行省參知政事明裏董阿、前宣政使答裏麻失裏，馳驛迎帝於江陵，密以意諭河南行省平章政事伯顏，令簡兵以備扈從。

translations.literal: He immediately dispatched former Henan Branch Secretariat associate administrator Mingli Dong'a and former transmission commissioner Dalimasheri by post relay to welcome the Emperor from Jiangling, secretly conveying his intent to Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Baran and ordering him to select troops to prepare as escort.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately dispatched former Henan Branch Secretariat associate administrator Mingli Dong'a and former transmission commissioner Dalimasheri by post relay to welcome the Emperor from Jiangling, secretly conveying his intent to Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Baran and ordering him to select troops to prepare as escort.

sentences.zh: 是日，前湖廣行省左丞相別不花為中書左丞相，太子詹事塔失海涯為中書平章政事，前湖廣行省右丞速速為中書左丞，前陜西行省參知政事王不憐吉臺為樞密副使，與中書右丞趙世延、同僉樞密院事燕鐵木兒、翰林學士承旨亦列赤、通政院使寒食分典機務，調兵守禦關要，征諸衛兵屯京師，下郡縣造兵器，出府庫犒軍士。

translations.literal: That day, former Huguang Branch Secretariat left chancellor Biebuhua was made central secretariat left chancellor; crown prince household director Tasihaiya was made central secretariat grand councillor; former Huguang Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Susu was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; former Shaanxi Branch Secretariat associate administrator Wang Bulunjatai was made associate privy council administrator; together with central secretariat right vice chancellor Zhao Shiyan, co-signatory privy council administrator Yan Temür, Hanlin academician exemplar Yiliechi, and transmission court commissioner Hanjie they shared in managing state affairs; troops were mobilized to guard strategic passes, garrison troops of the various guards were summoned to encamp at the capital, prefectures and counties were ordered to manufacture weapons, and treasury stores were opened to reward soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: That day, former Huguang Branch Secretariat left chancellor Biebuhua was made central secretariat left chancellor; crown prince household director Tasihaiya was made central secretariat grand councillor; former Huguang Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Susu was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; former Shaanxi Branch Secretariat associate administrator Wang Bulunjatai was made associate privy council administrator; together with central secretariat right vice chancellor Zhao Shiyan, co-signatory privy council administrator Yan Temür, Hanlin academician exemplar Yiliechi, and transmission court commissioner Hanjie they shared in managing state affairs; troops were mobilized to guard strategic passes, garrison troops of the various guards were summoned to encamp at the capital, prefectures and counties were ordered to manufacture weapons, and treasury stores were opened to reward soldiers.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒直宿禁中，達旦不寐，一夕或再徙，人莫知其處。

translations.literal: Yan Temür kept night watch in the forbidden precinct, staying awake until dawn; in one night he might move his lodging twice — no one knew his whereabouts.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür kept night watch in the forbidden precinct, staying awake until dawn; in one night he might move his lodging twice — no one knew his whereabouts.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以西安王令，給宿衛京城軍士鈔有差，調諸衛兵守居庸關及盧兒嶺。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, by order of the Prince of Xi'an, paper money was distributed in graded amounts to garrison soldiers guarding the capital, and garrison troops of the various guards were mobilized to hold Juyong Pass and Lu'er Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, by order of the Prince of Xi'an, paper money was distributed in graded amounts to garrison soldiers guarding the capital, and garrison troops of the various guards were mobilized to hold Juyong Pass and Lu'er Ridge.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣左衛率使禿魯將兵屯白馬甸，隆鎮衛指揮使斡都蠻將兵屯泰和嶺。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, left guard commander-in-chief Tolu was ordered to lead troops to encamp at Baima Meadow; Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Ordoman was ordered to lead troops to encamp at Taihe Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, left guard commander-in-chief Tolu was ordered to lead troops to encamp at Baima Meadow; Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Ordoman was ordered to lead troops to encamp at Taihe Ridge.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，發中衛兵守遷民鎮。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Central Guard troops were dispatched to garrison Qianmin Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Central Guard troops were dispatched to garrison Qianmin Fort.

sentences.zh: 又遣撒裏不花等往迎帝，且令塔失帖木兒矯為使者自南來，言帝已次近郊，使民毋驚疑。

translations.literal: Saribuhua and others were again dispatched to welcome the Emperor, and Tashi Temür was also ordered to feign being an envoy coming from the south, saying the Emperor had already halted near the suburbs, so the people should not be alarmed or suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Saribuhua and others were again dispatched to welcome the Emperor, and Tashi Temür was also ordered to feign being an envoy coming from the south, saying the Emperor had already halted near the suburbs, so the people should not be alarmed or suspicious.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，征宣靖王買奴、諸王燕不花於山東。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Prince of Xuanjing Bainu and Prince Yanbuhua were summoned from Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Prince of Xuanjing Bainu and Prince Yanbuhua were summoned from Shandong.

sentences.zh: 己亥，征兵遼陽。

translations.literal: On jihai day, troops were conscripted in Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, troops were conscripted in Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 明裏董阿至汴梁，執行省臣，皆下之獄，又收肅政廉訪司、萬戶府及郡縣印。

translations.literal: Mingli Dong'a reached Bianliang, seized the branch secretariat officials, and threw them all into prison; he also collected the seals of the surveillance commission, the office of commanders of ten-thousands, and prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Mingli Dong'a reached Bianliang, seized the branch secretariat officials, and threw them all into prison; he also collected the seals of the surveillance commission, the office of commanders of ten-thousands, and prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 庚子，發宗仁衛兵增守遷民鎮。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Zongren Guard troops were dispatched to reinforce the garrison at Qianmin Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zongren Guard troops were dispatched to reinforce the garrison at Qianmin Fort.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣萬戶徹裏帖木兒將兵屯河中。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, commander of ten-thousands Cheli Temür was dispatched to lead troops to encamp at Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, commander of ten-thousands Cheli Temür was dispatched to lead troops to encamp at Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，河南行省以郡縣闕人，權署官攝其事。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Henan Branch Secretariat, because prefectures and counties lacked personnel, temporarily appointed officials to administer affairs in their stead.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Henan Branch Secretariat, because prefectures and counties lacked personnel, temporarily appointed officials to administer affairs in their stead.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，燕鐵木兒之弟撒敦、子唐其勢，自上都來歸。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Yan Temür's younger brother Sadun and son Tangqishi came from Shangdu to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Yan Temür's younger brother Sadun and son Tangqishi came from Shangdu to submit.

sentences.zh: 河南行省殺平章曲烈、右丞別鐵木兒。

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat executed grand councillor Qul and right vice chancellor Bietemür.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat executed grand councillor Qul and right vice chancellor Bietemür.

sentences.zh: 是日，明裏董阿等至江陵。

translations.literal: That day, Mingli Dong'a and others reached Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: That day, Mingli Dong'a and others reached Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，帝發江陵，遣使召鎮南王鐵木兒不花、威順王寬徹不花、湖廣行省平章政事高昌王鐵木兒補化來會。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the Emperor departed Jiangling and dispatched envoys to summon Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa, Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua, and Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqhua to assemble.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor departed Jiangling and dispatched envoys to summon Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa, Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua, and Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqhua to assemble.

sentences.zh: 執湖廣行省左丞馬合某送京師，以別薛代之。

translations.literal: Huguang Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Mahema was seized and sent to the capital; Bieshe replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Mahema was seized and sent to the capital; Bieshe replaced him.

sentences.zh: 河南行省出府庫金千兩、銀四千兩、鈔七萬一千錠，分給官吏、將士。

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat disbursed from treasury stores one thousand taels of gold, four thousand taels of silver, and seventy-one thousand ingots of notes, distributing them to officials and commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat disbursed from treasury stores 1,000 taels of gold, 4,000 taels of silver, and 71,000 ingots of notes, distributing them to officials and commanders.

sentences.zh: 又命有司造乘輿、供張、儀仗等物。

translations.literal: The relevant offices were again ordered to manufacture the imperial carriage, furnishings, and ceremonial regalia.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices were again ordered to manufacture the imperial carriage, furnishings, and ceremonial regalia.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣隆鎮衛指揮使也速臺兒將兵守碑樓口。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Yesutai'er was dispatched to lead troops to garrison Beilou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Yesutai'er was dispatched to lead troops to garrison Beilou Pass.

sentences.zh: 河南行省殺其參政脫孛臺。

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat executed its associate administrator Tobutai.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat executed its associate administrator Tobutai.

sentences.zh: 召陜西行臺侍御史馬紮兒臺及行省平章政事探馬赤，不至。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Branch Surveillance supervising censor Mazhertai and branch secretariat grand councillor Tanmaqi were summoned but did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Branch Surveillance supervising censor Mazhertai and branch secretariat grand councillor Tanmaqi were summoned but did not come.

sentences.zh: 丙午，諸王按渾察至京師。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Prince Anhun arrived at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Prince Anhun arrived at the capital.

sentences.zh: 遣前西臺御史剌馬黑巴等諭陜西。

translations.literal: Former western surveillance censor Lamahaba and others were dispatched to proclaim the intent in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Former western surveillance censor Lamahaba and others were dispatched to proclaim the intent in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，撒敦守居庸關，唐其勢屯古北口。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Sadun guarded Juyong Pass and Tangqishi encamped at Gubeikou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Sadun guarded Juyong Pass and Tangqishi encamped at Gubeikou Pass.

sentences.zh: 命河南行省造銀符，以給軍士有功者。

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat was ordered to cast silver tallies to grant soldiers who had merit.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat was ordered to cast silver tallies to grant soldiers who had merit.

sentences.zh: 戊申，燕鐵木兒又令乃馬臺矯為使者北來，言周王整兵南行，聞者皆悅。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Yan Temür again ordered Naimatai to feign being an envoy coming from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling troops and marching south — those who heard were all pleased.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Yan Temür again ordered Naimatai to feign being an envoy coming from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling troops and marching south — those who heard were all pleased.

sentences.zh: 帝命河南行省平章政事伯顏為本省左丞相。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Baran to be made left chancellor of that province.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Baran to be made left chancellor of that province.

sentences.zh: 河南行省遣前萬戶孛羅等將兵守潼關。

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat dispatched former commander of ten-thousands Boluo and others to lead troops to garrison Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat dispatched former commander of ten-thousands Boluo and others to lead troops to garrison Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 己酉，諸王滿禿、阿馬剌臺，宗正紥魯忽赤闊闊出，前河南行平章政事買閭，集賢侍讀學士兀魯思不花，太常禮儀院使哈海赤等十八人，同謀援大都，事覺，倒剌沙殺之。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, princes Manu and Amalatai, clan prince registrar Kuokochu, former Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Mielun, Hanlin attendant reader academician Ulughsibuhua, and Grand Ceremonies Court commissioner Hahaqi — eighteen men in all — jointly plotted to aid Dadu; the plot was discovered and Doresh executed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, princes Manu and Amalatai, clan prince registrar Kuokochu, former Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Mielun, Hanlin attendant reader academician Ulughsibuhua, and Grand Ceremonies Court commissioner Hahaqi — 18 men in all — jointly plotted to aid Dadu; the plot was discovered and Doresh executed them.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝至汴梁，伯顏等扈從北行。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the Emperor reached Bianliang; Baran and others escorted him north.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor reached Bianliang; Baran and others escorted him north.

sentences.zh: 以前翰林學士承旨阿不海牙為河南行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Former Hanlin academician exemplar Abuhaiya was made Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hanlin academician exemplar Abuhaiya was made Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 發平灤民塹遷民鎮，以禦遼東軍。

translations.literal: The people of Pingluan were conscripted to dig trenches at Qianmin Fort to resist the Liaodong army.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Pingluan were conscripted to dig trenches at Qianmin Fort to resist the Liaodong army.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以燕鐵木兒知樞密院事，亦列赤為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Yan Temür was made privy council administrator and Yiliechi censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Yan Temür was made privy council administrator and Yiliechi censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，阿速衛指揮使脫脫木兒帥其軍自上都來歸，即命守古北口。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Asud Guard commander-in-chief Totuo Temür led his army from Shangdu to submit and was immediately ordered to guard Gubeikou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Asud Guard commander-in-chief Totuo Temür led his army from Shangdu to submit and was immediately ordered to guard Gubeikou Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，鑄樞密分院印。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the seal of the privy council branch office was cast.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the seal of the privy council branch office was cast.

sentences.zh: 是日，上都諸王及用事臣，以兵分道犯京畿，留遼王脫脫、諸王孛羅帖木兒、太師朵帶、左丞相倒剌沙、知樞密院事鐵木兒脫居守。

translations.literal: That day, Shangdu princes and ministers in power dispatched troops in separate columns to invade the capital region; Prince of Liaoning Toqto, Prince Borad Temür, Grand Preceptor Buqa, left chancellor Doresh, and privy council administrator Temür Toqto remained to guard Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That day, Shangdu princes and ministers in power dispatched troops in separate columns to invade the capital region; Prince of Liaoning Toqto, Prince Borad Temür, Grand Preceptor Buqa, left chancellor Doresh, and privy council administrator Temür Toqto remained to guard Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，剌馬黑巴等至陜西，皆見殺。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Lamahaba and others reached Shaanxi and were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Lamahaba and others reached Shaanxi and were all killed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，脫脫木兒及上都諸王失剌、平章政事乃馬臺、詹事欽察戰於宜興，斬欽察於陣，禽乃馬臺送京師，戮之，失剌敗走。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Totuo Temür together with Shangdu princes Shila, grand councillor Naimatai, and household director Qincha fought at Yixing; Qincha was beheaded in battle, Naimatai was captured and sent to the capital and executed, and Shila fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Totuo Temür together with Shangdu princes Shila, grand councillor Naimatai, and household director Qincha fought at Yixing; Qincha was beheaded in battle, Naimatai was captured and sent to the capital and executed, and Shila fled in defeat.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，燕鐵木兒奉法駕郊迎。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Yan Temür received the imperial carriage and went out to the suburbs to welcome it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Yan Temür received the imperial carriage and went out to the suburbs to welcome it.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，帝至京師，入居大內。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the Emperor reached the capital and entered to reside in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor reached the capital and entered to reside in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 貴赤衛指揮使脫叠出自上都，率其軍來歸，命守古北口。

translations.literal: Guich Guard commander-in-chief Tode came from Shangdu, led his army to submit, and was ordered to guard Gubeikou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Guich Guard commander-in-chief Tode came from Shangdu, led his army to submit, and was ordered to guard Gubeikou Pass.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以速速為中書平章政事，前御史中丞曹立為中書右丞，江浙行省參知政事張友諒為中書參知政事，河南行省左丞相伯顏為御史大夫，中書右丞趙世延為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Susu was made central secretariat grand councillor; former associate censor-in-chief Cao Li was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat associate administrator Zhang Youliang was made central secretariat associate administrator; Henan Branch Secretariat left chancellor Baran was made censor-in-chief; central secretariat right vice chancellor Zhao Shiyan was made associate censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Susu was made central secretariat grand councillor; former associate censor-in-chief Cao Li was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat associate administrator Zhang Youliang was made central secretariat associate administrator; Henan Branch Secretariat left chancellor Baran was made censor-in-chief; central secretariat right vice chancellor Zhao Shiyan was made associate censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己未，以河南萬戶也速臺兒同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Henan commander of ten-thousands Yesutai'er was made associate privy council administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Henan commander of ten-thousands Yesutai'er was made associate privy council administrator.

sentences.zh: 罷回回掌教哈的所。

translations.literal: The Huihui directorate of religious teaching under Haji was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Huihui directorate of religious teaching under Haji was abolished.

sentences.zh: 上都梁王王禪、右丞相塔失鐵木兒、太尉不花、平章政事買閭、御史大夫紐澤等，兵次榆林。

translations.literal: Shangdu Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, grand marshal Buqa, grand councillor Mielun, and censor-in-chief Niudze encamped their armies at Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, grand marshal Buqa, grand councillor Mielun, and censor-in-chief Niudze encamped their armies at Yulin.

sentences.zh: 升宜興縣為州。

translations.literal: Yixing County was promoted to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing County was promoted to prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隆鎮衛指揮使黑漢謀附上都，坐棄市，籍其家。

translations.literal: Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Heihan plotted to join Shangdu and was executed at the market; his household was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Heihan plotted to join Shangdu and was executed at the market; his household was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申朔，燕鐵木兒督師居庸關，遣撒敦以兵襲上都兵於榆林，擊敗之，追至懷來而還。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengshen new moon, Yan Temür supervised the army at Juyong Pass and dispatched Sadun with troops to strike Shangdu troops at Yulin, defeated them, pursued them to Huailai, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on gengshen new moon, Yan Temür supervised the army at Juyong Pass and dispatched Sadun with troops to strike Shangdu troops at Yulin, defeated them, pursued them to Huailai, and returned.

sentences.zh: 隆鎮衛指揮使斡都蠻以兵襲上都諸王滅裏鐵木兒、脫木赤於陀羅臺，執之，歸於京師。

translations.literal: Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Ordoman with troops struck Shangdu princes Mieli Temür and Temochi at Tuoluo Platform, seized them, and brought them back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Ordoman with troops struck Shangdu princes Mieli Temür and Temochi at Tuoluo Platform, seized them, and brought them back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 遣使即軍中賜脫脫木兒等銀各千兩，以分給軍士有功者。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to the army to grant Totuo Temür and others one thousand taels of silver each, to be distributed to meritorious soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to the army to grant Totuo Temür and others 1,000 taels of silver each, to be distributed to meritorious soldiers.

sentences.zh: 賜京師耆老七十人幣帛。

translations.literal: Silks and cloth were granted to seventy elders of age in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Silks and cloth were granted to 70 elders of age in the capital.

sentences.zh: 命有司括馬。

translations.literal: The relevant offices were ordered to requisition horses.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices were ordered to requisition horses.

sentences.zh: 中書左丞相別不花言：「回回人哈哈的，自至治間貨官鈔，違制別往番邦，得寶貨無算，法當沒官，而倒剌沙私其種人，不許，今請籍其家。

translations.literal: Central secretariat left chancellor Biebuhua said: "The Huihui Haha De, from the Zhizhi period onward, borrowed official notes in violation of regulations and separately went to foreign lands, obtaining treasure goods beyond reckoning — by law his property should be confiscated; yet Doresh privately favored his tribesmen and would not allow it; now we request that his household be registered.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat left chancellor Biebuhua said, "The Huihui Haha De, from the Zhizhi period onward, borrowed official notes in violation of regulations and separately went to foreign lands, obtaining treasure goods beyond reckoning — by law his property should be confiscated; yet Doresh privately favored his tribesmen and would not allow it; now we request that his household be registered.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒請釋馬合某，從之。

translations.literal: Yan Temür requested the release of Mahema; approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür requested the release of Mahema; approved.

sentences.zh: 陜西兵入河中府，劫行用庫鈔萬八千錠，殺同知府事不倫禿。

translations.literal: Shaanxi troops entered Hezhong Prefecture, plundered eighteen thousand ingots of notes from the circulating treasury, and killed associate prefect Buluntu.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops entered Hezhong Prefecture, plundered 18,000 ingots of notes from the circulating treasury, and killed associate prefect Buluntu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣使祭五嶽、四瀆。

translations.literal: On renxu day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Mountains and Four Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Mountains and Four Rivers.

sentences.zh: 命速速宣諭中外曰：「昔在世祖以及列聖臨御，咸命中書省綱維百司，總裁庶政，凡錢谷、銓選、刑罰、興造，罔不司之。

translations.literal: Susu was ordered to proclaim to the court and countryside: "Formerly under Shizu and the successive sage emperors who ruled, all ordered the Central Secretariat to hold the hundred offices in harness, oversee all government, and manage money and grain, appointments, punishments, and construction — nothing was outside its charge.
translations.idiomatic: Susu was ordered to proclaim to the court and countryside, "Formerly under Shizu and the successive sage emperors who ruled, all ordered the Central Secretariat to hold the hundred offices in harness, oversee all government, and manage money and grain, appointments, punishments, and construction — nothing was outside its charge.

sentences.zh: 自今除樞密院、御史臺，其餘諸司及左右近侍，敢有隔越中書奏請政務者，以違制論，監察御史其糾言之。

translations.literal: From now on, apart from the Privy Council and the Censorate, if any other office or attendant at left or right dares to bypass the Central Secretariat in memorializing on government affairs, it shall be judged violation of regulations; supervising censors shall impeach and report it.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, apart from the Privy Council and the Censorate, if any other office or attendant at left or right dares to bypass the Central Secretariat in memorializing on government affairs, it shall be judged violation of regulations; supervising censors shall impeach and report it.

sentences.zh: 」以高昌王鐵木兒補化知樞密院事，也先捏為宣徽使。

translations.literal: " Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqhua was made privy council administrator and Yesianier palace provision commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: " Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqhua was made privy council administrator and Yesianier palace provision commissioner.

sentences.zh: 給居庸關軍士糗糧，賜鎮南王鐵木兒不花等鈔有差。

translations.literal: Provisions were supplied to soldiers at Juyong Pass, and notes were granted in graded amounts to Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa and others.
translations.idiomatic: Provisions were supplied to soldiers at Juyong Pass, and notes were granted in graded amounts to Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa and others.

sentences.zh: 征五衛屯田兵赴京師。

translations.literal: Garrison-farming troops of the Five Guards were conscripted to encamp at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison-farming troops of the Five Guards were conscripted to encamp at the capital.

sentences.zh: 安南國來貢方物。

translations.literal: Annam came to court to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: Annam came to court to present local products.

sentences.zh: 賜上都將士來歸者鈔各有差。

translations.literal: Notes were granted in graded amounts to commanders and soldiers from Shangdu who came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Notes were granted in graded amounts to commanders and soldiers from Shangdu who came to submit.

sentences.zh: 樞密院臣言：「河南行省軍列戍淮西，距潼關、河中不遠，湖廣行省軍，唯平陽、保定兩萬戶號稱精銳，請發蘄、黃戍軍一萬人及兩萬戶軍，為三萬，命湖廣參政鄭昂霄、萬戶脫脫木兒將之，並黃河為營，以便征遣。

translations.literal: Privy Council officials said: "Henan Branch Secretariat troops are arrayed on garrison duty west of the Huai River, not far from Tong Pass and Hezhong; Huguang Branch Secretariat troops — only the two commands of ten-thousands at Pingyang and Baoding are called elite — we request that ten thousand garrison troops from Qi and Huang be mobilized together with the two commands of ten-thousands, making thirty thousand, and that Huguang associate administrator Zheng Angxiao and commander of ten-thousands Totuo Temür lead them, encamping along the Yellow River for convenient dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council officials said, "Henan Branch Secretariat troops are arrayed on garrison duty west of the Huai River, not far from Tong Pass and Hezhong; Huguang Branch Secretariat troops — only the two commands of ten-thousands at Pingyang and Baoding are called elite — we request that 10,000 garrison troops from Qi and Huang be mobilized together with the two commands of ten-thousands, making 30,000, and that Huguang associate administrator Zheng Angxiao and commander of ten-thousands Totuo Temür lead them, encamping along the Yellow River for convenient dispatch.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 召燕鐵木兒赴闕。

translations.literal: Yan Temür was summoned to audience at court.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür was summoned to audience at court.

sentences.zh: 上都諸王也先帖木兒、平章禿滿叠兒，自遼東以兵入遷民鎮，諸王八剌馬、也先帖木兒以所部兵入管州，殺掠吏民。

translations.literal: Shangdu princes Yesi Temür and grand councillor Tuman De'er entered Qianmin Fort with troops from Liaodong; princes Barama and Yesi Temür entered Guan Prefecture with their subordinate troops, killing and plundering officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu princes Yesi Temür and grand councillor Tuman De'er entered Qianmin Fort with troops from Liaodong; princes Barama and Yesi Temür entered Guan Prefecture with their subordinate troops, killing and plundering officials and people.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命造兵器，江浙、江西、湖廣三省六萬事，內郡四萬事。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, weapons were ordered manufactured — sixty thousand sets in the three provinces of Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang, and forty thousand sets in the inner prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, weapons were ordered manufactured — 60,000 sets in the three provinces of Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang, and 40,000 sets in the inner prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，燕鐵木兒率諸王、大臣伏闕請早正大位，以安天下，帝固辭曰：「大兄在朔方，朕敢紊天序乎？

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Yan Temür led the princes and great ministers to prostrate themselves at the palace gate and request early rectification of the Great Foundation to settle all under Heaven; the Emperor firmly declined, saying, "My elder brother is in the northern desert — how dare I disorder Heaven's order?
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Yan Temür led the princes and great ministers to prostrate themselves at the palace gate and request early rectification of the Great Foundation to settle all under Heaven; the Emperor firmly declined, saying, "My elder brother is in the northern desert — how dare I disorder Heaven's order?

sentences.zh: 」燕鐵木兒曰：「人心向背之機，間不容發，一或失之，噬臍無及。

translations.literal: " Yan Temür said: "The moment when hearts turn toward or away from one is a gap that admits no delay — once lost, there will be no time to regret.
translations.idiomatic: " Yan Temür said, "The moment when hearts turn toward or away from one is a gap that admits no delay — once lost, there will be no time to regret.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「必不得已，必明著朕意以示天下而後可。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "If it cannot be avoided, my intent must first be made clear and shown to all under Heaven — only then may it be done.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "If it cannot be avoided, my intent must first be made clear and shown to all under Heaven — only then may it be done.

sentences.zh: 」賜西安王阿剌忒納失裏、鎮南王帖木兒不花、威順王寬徹不花、宣靖王買奴等，金各五十兩、銀各五百兩、幣各三十匹。

translations.literal: " Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri, Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa, Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua, Prince of Xuanjing Bainu, and others were each granted fifty taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and thirty bolts of silks.
translations.idiomatic: " Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri, Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa, Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua, Prince of Xuanjing Bainu, and others were each granted 50 taels of gold, 500 taels of silver, and 30 bolts of silks.

sentences.zh: 遣撒敦拒遼東兵於薊州東流沙河，元帥阿兀剌守居庸關。

translations.literal: Sadun was dispatched to hold the Liaodong army at Dongliu Sha River east of Jizhou; marshal Arigh was ordered to guard Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Sadun was dispatched to hold the Liaodong army at Dongliu Sha River east of Jizhou; marshal Arigh was ordered to guard Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 上都軍攻碑樓口，指揮使也速臺兒禦之，不克。

translations.literal: Shangdu troops attacked Beilou Pass; commander Yeshutai'er defended it but could not overcome them.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu troops attacked Beilou Pass; commander Yeshutai'er defended it but could not overcome them.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大司農明裏董阿、大都留守闊闊臺，並為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On wuchen day grand minister of agriculture Mingli Dong'a and Dadu garrison commissioner Kuokuotai were both made central secretariat grand councillors.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day grand minister of agriculture Mingli Dong'a and Dadu garrison commissioner Kuokuotai were both made central secretariat grand councillors.

sentences.zh: 募勇士從軍。

translations.literal: Brave men were recruited for military service.
translations.idiomatic: Brave men were recruited for military service.

sentences.zh: 遣使分行河間、保定、真定及河南等路，括民馬。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched in separate columns through Hejian, Baoding, Zhending, and Henan routes and others to requisition civilian horses.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched in separate columns through Hejian, Baoding, Zhending, and Henan routes and others to requisition civilian horses.

sentences.zh: 征鄢陵縣河西軍赴闕。

translations.literal: The Hexi Army of Yanling County was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexi Army of Yanling County was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 命襄陽萬戶楊克忠、鄧州萬戶孫節，以兵守武關。

translations.literal: Xiangyang commander of ten-thousands Yang Kezhong and Dengzhou commander of ten-thousands Sun Jie were ordered to hold Wuguan Pass with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang commander of ten-thousands Yang Kezhong and Dengzhou commander of ten-thousands Sun Jie were ordered to hold Wuguan Pass with troops.

sentences.zh: 命海道萬戶府來年運米三百一十萬石。

translations.literal: The Sea Route Office of Commanders of Ten-Thousands was ordered to transport three million one hundred thousand shi of grain the following year.
translations.idiomatic: The Sea Route Office of Commanders of Ten-Thousands was ordered to transport 3,100,000 shi of grain the following year.

sentences.zh: 造金符八十。

translations.literal: Eighty gold tallies were cast.
translations.idiomatic: 80 gold tallies were cast.

sentences.zh: 己巳，鑄御寶成。

translations.literal: On jisi day casting of the imperial seal was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day casting of the imperial seal was completed.

sentences.zh: 立行樞密院於汴梁，以同知樞密院事也速臺兒知行樞密院事，將兵行視太行諸關，西擊河中、潼關軍，以折疊弩分給守關軍士。

translations.literal: A traveling privy council was established at Bianliang; associate privy council administrator Yeshutai'er was made to administer the traveling privy council, leading troops to inspect the passes of the Taihang range, striking west against the armies of Hezhong and Tong Pass, and distributing folding crossbows to the garrison troops holding the passes.
translations.idiomatic: A traveling privy council was established at Bianliang; associate privy council administrator Yeshutai'er was made to administer the traveling privy council, leading troops to inspect the passes of the Taihang range, striking west against the armies of Hezhong and Tong Pass, and distributing folding crossbows to the garrison troops holding the passes.

sentences.zh: 上都諸王忽剌臺等引兵犯崞州。

translations.literal: Shangdu princes including Hulatai led troops to invade Guo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu princes including Hulatai led troops to invade Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命有司和市粟豆十六萬五千石，分給居庸等關軍馬。

translations.literal: On gengwu day the relevant offices were ordered to purchase one hundred sixty-five thousand shi of grain and beans on the market and distribute them to the troops and horses at Juyong Pass and other passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the relevant offices were ordered to purchase 165,000 shi of grain and beans on the market and distribute them to the troops and horses at Juyong Pass and other passes.

sentences.zh: 遣軍民守歸、峽諸隘。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians were dispatched to guard the defiles at Gui and Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians were dispatched to guard the defiles at Gui and Xia.

sentences.zh: 辛未，常服謁太廟。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, in ordinary dress, he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, in ordinary dress, he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 雲南孟定路土官來貢方物。

translations.literal: The native official of Mengding Route in Yunnan came to court to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: The native official of Mengding Route in Yunnan came to court to present local products.

sentences.zh: 烏伯都剌、鐵木哥棄市，朵朵、王士熙、伯顏察兒、脫歡等各流於遠州，並籍其家。

translations.literal: Ubaidullah and Temürge were executed at the market; Duodu, Wang Shixi, Barqachar, Toqan, and others were each exiled to distant prefectures, and their households were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Ubaidullah and Temürge were executed at the market; Duodu, Wang Shixi, Barqachar, Toqan, and others were each exiled to distant prefectures, and their households were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 同知樞密院事脫脫木兒與遼東禿滿叠兒戰於薊州兩家店。

translations.literal: Associate privy council administrator Toqtoghan fought Tuman De'er of Liaodong at Liangjiadian in Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Associate privy council administrator Toqtoghan fought Tuman De'er of Liaodong at Liangjiadian in Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，帝即位於大明殿，受諸王、百官朝賀，大赦，詔曰：

translations.literal: On renshen day the Emperor took the throne in Daming Hall, received congratulations from the princes and hundred officials, and proclaimed a general amnesty; the edict said:
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor took the throne in Daming Hall, received congratulations from the princes and hundred officials, and proclaimed a general amnesty; the edict said:

sentences.zh: 洪惟我太祖皇帝混一海宇，爰立定制，以一統緒，宗親各受分地，勿敢妄生覬覦，此不易之成規，萬世所共守者也。

translations.literal: Greatly do We reflect that Our Founding Emperor unified the realm within the four seas, thereupon established fixed institutions, and with a single succession line had kinsmen each receive allotted domains — none dared rashly harbor covetous designs; this is an immutable settled rule, to be jointly upheld for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly do We reflect that Our Founding Emperor unified the realm within the four seas, thereupon established fixed institutions, and with a single succession line had kinsmen each receive allotted domains — none dared rashly harbor covetous designs; this is an immutable settled rule, to be jointly upheld for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 世祖之後，成宗、武宗、仁宗、英宗，以公天下之心，以次相傳，宗王、貴戚，咸遵祖訓。

translations.literal: After Shizu, Chengzong, Wuzong, Renzong, and Yingzong, with a mind of holding the realm in common, passed the throne in order; princes and noble kinsmen all obeyed the ancestral instruction.
translations.idiomatic: After Shizu, Chengzong, Wuzong, Renzong, and Yingzong, with a mind of holding the realm in common, passed the throne in order; princes and noble kinsmen all obeyed the ancestral instruction.

sentences.zh: 至於晉邸，具有盟書，願守藩服，而與賊臣鐵失、也先帖木兒等潛通陰謀，冒干寶位，使英宗不幸罹於大故。

translations.literal: As for the Jin residence, there existed covenant documents pledging to keep to princely service; yet together with the traitorous ministers Tieshi, Yesen Temür, and others he secretly maintained a hidden plot, presumptuously encroached on the imperial seat, and caused Yingzong unhappily to meet with great misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: As for the Jin residence, there existed covenant documents pledging to keep to princely service; yet together with the traitorous ministers Tieshi, Yesen Temür, and others he secretly maintained a hidden plot, presumptuously encroached on the imperial seat, and caused Yingzong unhappily to meet with great misfortune.

sentences.zh: 朕兄弟播越南北，備歷艱險，臨御之事，豈獲與聞！

translations.literal: We brothers were driven to wander north and south, fully enduring hardship and peril; how could We have shared in matters of rule!
translations.idiomatic: We brothers were driven to wander north and south, fully enduring hardship and peril; how could We have shared in matters of rule!

sentences.zh: 朕以叔父之故，順承惟謹，於今六年，災異叠見。

translations.literal: Because of Our uncle's position We dutifully accepted succession in compliance; for six years now, calamities and portents have repeatedly appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Because of Our uncle's position We dutifully accepted succession in compliance; for 6 years now, calamities and portents have repeatedly appeared.

sentences.zh: 權臣倒剌沙、烏伯都剌等，專權自用，疏遠勛舊，廢棄忠良，變亂祖宗法度，空府庫以私其黨類。

translations.literal: Powerful ministers Doresh, Ubaidullah, and others monopolized authority and acted on their own judgment, kept meritorious old followers at a distance, discarded the loyal and good, altered and overturned the ancestral institutions, and emptied the treasury to enrich their faction.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful ministers Doresh, Ubaidullah, and others monopolized authority and acted on their own judgment, kept meritorious old followers at a distance, discarded the loyal and good, altered and overturned the ancestral institutions, and emptied the treasury to enrich their faction.

sentences.zh: 大行上賓，利於立幼，顯握國柄，用成其奸。

translations.literal: When the late emperor became Heaven's guest, they took advantage of installing a minor, openly grasped the reins of state, and thereby accomplished their treachery.
translations.idiomatic: When the late emperor became Heaven's guest, they took advantage of installing a minor, openly grasped the reins of state, and thereby accomplished their treachery.

sentences.zh: 宗王、大臣，以宗社之重，統緒之正，協謀推戴，屬於眇躬。

translations.literal: Princes and great ministers, because of the weight of the altars of state and the correctness of the succession line, joined in counsel to support and install Us, their slight person.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and great ministers, because of the weight of the altars of state and the correctness of the succession line, joined in counsel to support and install Us, their slight person.

sentences.zh: 朕以菲德，宜俟大兄，固讓再三。

translations.literal: We, of meager virtue, ought to await Our elder brother and firmly yielded again and again.
translations.idiomatic: We, of meager virtue, ought to await Our elder brother and firmly yielded again and again.

sentences.zh: 宗戚、將相，百僚、耆老，以為神器不可以久虛，天下不可以無主，周王遼隔朔漠，民庶遑遑，已及三月，誠懇迫切。

translations.literal: Imperial kinsmen, generals and chancellors, the hundred officials, and elders of age held that the imperial regalia could not long remain vacant and the realm could not be without a ruler; the Prince of Zhou was far separated in the northern desert, and the people were anxious — already three months had passed, and their earnest pleas were urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial kinsmen, generals and chancellors, the hundred officials, and elders of age held that the imperial regalia could not long remain vacant and the realm could not be without a ruler; the Prince of Zhou was far separated in the northern desert, and the people were anxious — already 3 months had passed, and their earnest pleas were urgent.

sentences.zh: 朕故從其請，謹俟大兄之至，以遂朕固讓之心。

translations.literal: We therefore acceded to their request, respectfully awaiting Our elder brother's arrival, to fulfill Our firm intent to yield.
translations.idiomatic: We therefore acceded to their request, respectfully awaiting Our elder brother's arrival, to fulfill Our firm intent to yield.

sentences.zh: 已於致和元年九月十三日，即皇帝位於大明殿，其以致和元年為天歷元年，可大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the ninth month of the first year of Zhihe, We already took the imperial throne in Daming Hall; let the first year of Zhihe be renamed the first year of Tianli, and a general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the 13th day of the ninth month of the first year of Zhihe, We already took the imperial throne in Daming Hall; let the first year of Zhihe be renamed the first year of Tianli, and a general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 自九月十三日昧爽已前，除謀殺祖父母、父母，妻妾殺夫，奴婢殺主，謀故殺人，但犯強盜，印造偽鈔不赦外，其餘罪無輕重，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Before dawn on the thirteenth day of the ninth month, except for plotting to kill grandparents or parents, a wife or concubine killing her husband, a slave killing his master, plotting deliberate murder, robbery in general, and forging counterfeit notes — which are not pardoned — all other crimes, whether light or heavy, are alike remitted and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn on the 13th day of the ninth month, except for plotting to kill grandparents or parents, a wife or concubine killing her husband, a slave killing his master, plotting deliberate murder, robbery in general, and forging counterfeit notes — which are not pardoned — all other crimes, whether light or heavy, are alike remitted and abolished.

sentences.zh: 於戲，朕豈有意於天下哉！

translations.literal: Alas, had We any intent toward the realm!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, had We any intent toward the realm!

sentences.zh: 重念祖宗開創之艱，恐隳大業，是以勉徇輿情。

translations.literal: Deeply reflecting on the hardship of the ancestors' founding, fearing the ruin of the great enterprise, We therefore reluctantly followed the will of the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply reflecting on the hardship of the ancestors' founding, fearing the ruin of the great enterprise, We therefore reluctantly followed the will of the multitude.

sentences.zh: 尚賴爾中外文武臣僚，協心相予，輯寧億兆，以成治功。

translations.literal: We still rely on you civil and military ministers within and without to join hearts in assisting Us, to bring peace to the hundred millions, and to accomplish the work of good governance.
translations.idiomatic: We still rely on you civil and military ministers within and without to join hearts in assisting Us, to bring peace to the hundred millions, and to accomplish the work of good governance.

sentences.zh: 咨爾多方，體予至意！

translations.literal: We address you in all quarters — embody Our utmost intent!
translations.idiomatic: We address you in all quarters — embody Our utmost intent!

sentences.zh: 癸酉，翰林院增給驛璽書。

translations.literal: On guiyou day additional relay-seal dispatches were granted to the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day additional relay-seal dispatches were granted to the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 命燕鐵木兒將兵擊遼東軍，封燕鐵木兒為太平王，以太平路為食邑，賜金五百兩、銀二千五百兩、鈔萬錠、平江官地五百頃。

translations.literal: Yan Temür was ordered to lead troops against the Liaodong army; Yan Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Taiping, with Taiping Route as his fief; he was granted five hundred taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, ten thousand ingots of notes, and five hundred qing of Pingjiang official land.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür was ordered to lead troops against the Liaodong army; Yan Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Taiping, with Taiping Route as his fief; he was granted 500 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, 10,000 ingots of notes, and 500 qing of Pingjiang official land.

sentences.zh: 中書右丞曹立為江浙行省平章政事，福建廉訪使易釋董阿為右丞，前中書左丞張思明為左丞。

translations.literal: Central secretariat right vice chancellor Cao Li was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor; Fujian surveillance commissioner Yishidong'a was made right vice chancellor; former central secretariat left vice chancellor Zhang Siming was made left vice chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat right vice chancellor Cao Li was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor; Fujian surveillance commissioner Yishidong'a was made right vice chancellor; former central secretariat left vice chancellor Zhang Siming was made left vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 諸王塔術、只兒哈郎、佛寶等自恩州來朝。

translations.literal: Princes Tashu, Jirhalang, Fobao, and others came to court from En Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Tashu, Jirhalang, Fobao, and others came to court from En Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賜按灰鈔百錠，以祀天神。

translations.literal: Anhui was granted one hundred ingots of notes for sacrifice to the Heavenly Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui was granted 100 ingots of notes for sacrifice to the Heavenly Spirit.

sentences.zh: 括河東馬。

translations.literal: Horses were requisitioned in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Horses were requisitioned in Hedong.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，燕鐵木兒加開府儀同三司、上柱國、錄軍國重事、中書右丞相、監修國史，依前知樞密院事，伯顏加太尉，以江南行臺御史大夫朵兒只為江浙行省左丞相，淮西道肅政廉訪使阿兒思蘭海牙為江南行臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Yan Temür was additionally invested commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, pillar of state of the upper grade, recorder of state military affairs, central secretariat right chancellor, and supervisor of the state history, while still administering the privy council as before; Bayan was made grand marshal; Jiangnan branch censor-in-chief Durji was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left chancellor; Huai-Xi circuit surveillance commissioner Arslan Qaya was made Jiangnan branch censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yan Temür was additionally invested commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, pillar of state of the upper grade, recorder of state military affairs, central secretariat right chancellor, and supervisor of the state history, while still administering the privy council as before; Bayan was made grand marshal; Jiangnan branch censor-in-chief Durji was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left chancellor; Huai-Xi circuit surveillance commissioner Arslan Qaya was made Jiangnan branch censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 諸王孛羅、忽都火者來朝。

translations.literal: Princes Bolad and Quduqa came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Bolad and Quduqa came to court.

sentences.zh: 征左右兩阿速衛軍老幼赴京師，不行者斬，籍其家。

translations.literal: The old and young of the left and right Asud guard corps were summoned to the capital; those who did not go were beheaded and their households confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: The old and young of the left and right Asud guard corps were summoned to the capital; those who did not go were beheaded and their households confiscated.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，立太禧院，以奉祖宗神御殿祠祭，秩正二品，罷會福、殊祥兩院。

translations.literal: On yihai day the Grand Felicitous Court was established to perform sacrifice at the spirit halls of the ancestral imperial portraits, rank 2a; the Huifu and Zhuxiang courts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Grand Felicitous Court was established to perform sacrifice at the spirit halls of the ancestral imperial portraits, rank 2a; the Huifu and Zhuxiang courts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 江西行省平章政事禿堅帖木兒、江浙行省右丞易釋董阿並為太禧院使，中書平章速速、御史中丞亦列赤兼太禧院使。

translations.literal: Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Tuq Temür and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat right vice chancellor Yishidong'a were both made commissioners of the Grand Felicitous Court; central secretariat grand councillor Susu and censorate vice commissioner Yilechi were both additionally commissioners of the Grand Felicitous Court.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Tuq Temür and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat right vice chancellor Yishidong'a were both made commissioners of the Grand Felicitous Court; central secretariat grand councillor Susu and censorate vice commissioner Yilechi were both additionally commissioners of the Grand Felicitous Court.

sentences.zh: 上都王禪兵襲破居庸關，將士皆潰。

translations.literal: Shangdu Prince Wang Chan's troops made a surprise attack and broke through Juyong Pass; officers and soldiers all fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu Prince Wang Chan's troops made a surprise attack and broke through Juyong Pass; officers and soldiers all fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒軍次三河。

translations.literal: Yan Temür's army halted at Sanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür's army halted at Sanhe.

sentences.zh: 丙子，王禪遊兵至大口，燕鐵木兒還軍次榆河，帝出齊化門視師。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Wang Chan's roaming troops reached Dakou; Yan Temür returned with his army and halted at the Yu River; the Emperor went out through Qihua Gate to review the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Wang Chan's roaming troops reached Dakou; Yan Temür returned with his army and halted at the Yu River; the Emperor went out through Qihua Gate to review the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，燕鐵木兒來見曰：「乘輿一出，民心必驚，軍旅之事，臣請以身任之。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Yan Temür came to see him and said, "Once the imperial carriage goes forth, the people's hearts will surely be alarmed; as for military affairs, your subject asks to take them upon himself.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Yan Temür came to see him and said, "Once the imperial carriage goes forth, the people's hearts will surely be alarmed; as for military affairs, your subject asks to take them upon himself.

sentences.zh: 」即日還宮。

translations.literal: " That same day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " That same day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 命司天監翙星。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，諭中外曰：「近以奸臣倒剌沙、烏伯都剌潛通陰謀，變易祖宗成憲，既已明正其罪。

translations.literal: On wuyin day an edict was proclaimed to the court and countryside: "Recently the traitorous ministers Doresh and Ubaidullah secretly maintained a hidden plot and altered the ancestral settled institutions; their crimes have already been clearly rectified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict was proclaimed to the court and countryside: "Recently the traitorous ministers Doresh and Ubaidullah secretly maintained a hidden plot and altered the ancestral settled institutions; their crimes have already been clearly rectified.

sentences.zh: 凡回回種人不預其事者，其安業勿懼；

translations.literal: All Muslims who did not participate in the affair may keep their livelihoods and need not fear;
translations.idiomatic: All Muslims who did not participate in the affair may keep their livelihoods and need not fear;

sentences.zh: 有因而扇惑其人者，罪之。

translations.literal: whoever incites and deludes others among them shall be punished.
translations.idiomatic: whoever incites and deludes others among them shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 」又敕：「軍中逃歸，及京城遊民敢攘民財者斬。

translations.literal: " An order was also issued: "Soldiers who desert and return, and vagrants in the capital who dare plunder the people's property, shall be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: " An order was also issued: "Soldiers who desert and return, and vagrants in the capital who dare plunder the people's property, shall be beheaded.

sentences.zh: 」命高昌僧作佛事於延春閣。

translations.literal: " Gaochang monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Yanchun Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: " Gaochang monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Yanchun Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 又命也裏可溫於顯懿莊聖皇后神御殿作佛事。

translations.literal: Nestorian Christians were also ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the spirit hall of Empress Manifest Virtue and Solemn Sage.
translations.idiomatic: Nestorian Christians were also ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the spirit hall of Empress Manifest Virtue and Solemn Sage.

sentences.zh: 諸王阿兒八忽、按灰、脫脫來朝。

translations.literal: Princes Arbaqu, Anhui, and Toqto came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Arbaqu, Anhui, and Toqto came to court.

sentences.zh: 命留守司完京城，軍士乘城守禦。

translations.literal: The garrison commissioner was ordered to complete the capital's defenses; soldiers manned the walls for defense.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison commissioner was ordered to complete the capital's defenses; soldiers manned the walls for defense.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒與王禪前軍戰於榆河，敗之，追奔紅橋北。

translations.literal: Yan Temür fought Wang Chan's vanguard at the Yu River, defeated them, and pursued the rout north of Red Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür fought Wang Chan's vanguard at the Yu River, defeated them, and pursued the rout north of Red Bridge.

sentences.zh: 其樞密副使阿剌帖木兒、指揮使忽都帖木兒以兵會王禪，復來戰，又敗之，我師據紅橋。

translations.literal: Associate privy council administrator Alaltemür and commander Qudu Temür joined Wang Chan with troops and came again to give battle; they were again defeated, and Our army held Red Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Associate privy council administrator Alaltemür and commander Qudu Temür joined Wang Chan with troops and came again to give battle; they were again defeated, and Our army held Red Bridge.

sentences.zh: 增給大都驛馬百匹。

translations.literal: An additional one hundred relay horses were granted to Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: An additional 100 relay horses were granted to Dadu.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太白犯亢宿。

translations.literal: On gengchen day the Metal Star violated the Horn constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Metal Star violated the Horn constellation.

sentences.zh: 詔諭御史臺：「今後監察御史、廉訪司，凡有刺舉，並著其實，無則勿妄以言。

translations.literal: An edict instructed the censorate: "Henceforth surveillance censors and surveillance commissioners, in all impeachments, must set forth the facts; where there are none, do not speak rashly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed the censorate: "Henceforth surveillance censors and surveillance commissioners, in all impeachments, must set forth the facts; where there are none, do not speak rashly.

sentences.zh: 廉訪司書吏，當以職官、教授、吏員、鄉貢進士參用。

translations.literal: Surveillance office clerks should be appointed jointly from officeholders, instructors, clerks, and provincial graduates.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance office clerks should be appointed jointly from officeholders, instructors, clerks, and provincial graduates.

sentences.zh: 」加封漢將軍關羽為顯靈義勇武安英濟王，遣使祠其廟。

translations.literal: " Additional enfeoffment was granted to Han general Guan Yu as Prince Manifest Spirit, Righteous, Valorous, Martial, and Restorative; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at his temple.
translations.idiomatic: " Additional enfeoffment was granted to Han general Guan Yu as Prince Manifest Spirit, Righteous, Valorous, Martial, and Restorative; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at his temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命司天監翙星。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.

sentences.zh: 以別不花知樞密院事，依前中書左丞相。

translations.literal: Bayanbuluq was made privy council administrator, while still central secretariat left grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Bayanbuluq was made privy council administrator, while still central secretariat left grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 括山東馬。

translations.literal: Horses were requisitioned in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Horses were requisitioned in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒與上都軍大戰白浮之野，燕鐵木兒手刃七人於陣，敗之。

translations.literal: Yan Temür fought a great battle with the Shangdu army on the plain of Baifu; Yan Temür personally slew seven men in the ranks and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür fought a great battle with the Shangdu army on the plain of Baifu; Yan Temür personally slew 7 men in the ranks and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 脫脫木兒與遼東軍戰薊州之檀子山。

translations.literal: Toqtoghan fought the Liaodong army at Tanzishan in Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Toqtoghan fought the Liaodong army at Tanzishan in Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大霧。

translations.literal: On renwu day there was heavy fog.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day there was heavy fog.

sentences.zh: 王禪等遁昆山州。

translations.literal: Wang Chan and others fled to Kunshan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chan and others fled to Kunshan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 獲上都頒詔使者及遼東征兵使者以聞，詔誅之。

translations.literal: Envoys bearing edicts from Shangdu and envoys mobilizing troops from Liaodong were captured and reported; an edict ordered them executed.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys bearing edicts from Shangdu and envoys mobilizing troops from Liaodong were captured and reported; an edict ordered them executed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以同知樞密院事禿兒哈帖木兒知樞密院事，中書平章政事明裏董阿為江浙行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On guiwei day associate privy council administrator Toghan Temür was made privy council administrator; central secretariat grand councillor Mingli Dong'a was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day associate privy council administrator Toghan Temür was made privy council administrator; central secretariat grand councillor Mingli Dong'a was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 王禪收集散亡，復來戰，我師列陣白浮之西，敵不敢犯。

translations.literal: Wang Chan gathered the scattered and came again to give battle; Our army drew up ranks west of Baifu, and the enemy did not dare attack.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chan gathered the scattered and came again to give battle; Our army drew up ranks west of Baifu, and the enemy did not dare attack.

sentences.zh: 至夜，撒敦、脫脫木兒前後夾攻，敗走之，追及於昌平北，斬首數千級，降者萬餘人。

translations.literal: By night Sadun and Toqtoghan attacked from front and rear, defeated and drove them off, pursued them north of Changping, beheaded several thousand, and accepted the surrender of more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: By night Sadun and Toqtoghan attacked from front and rear, defeated and drove them off, pursued them north of Changping, beheaded several thousand, and accepted the surrender of more than 10,000.

sentences.zh: 帝遣使賜燕鐵木兒上尊，諭旨曰：「丞相每臨陣，躬冒矢石，脫有不虞，奈何？

translations.literal: The Emperor dispatched envoys to grant Yan Temür imperial wine and instructed him: "Each time the chancellor goes into battle he personally braves arrows and stones; if unexpectedly something should happen, what then?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor dispatched envoys to grant Yan Temür imperial wine and instructed him: "Each time the chancellor goes into battle he personally braves arrows and stones; if unexpectedly something should happen, what then?

sentences.zh: 自今第以大將旗鼓督戰可也。

translations.literal: From now on it will suffice to direct the battle with the great general's banner and drum.
translations.idiomatic: From now on it will suffice to direct the battle with the great general's banner and drum.

sentences.zh: 」燕鐵木兒對曰：「凡戰，臣必以身先之，敢後者，論以軍法。

translations.literal: " Yan Temür replied, "In every battle your subject must take the lead in person; whoever dares hang back is judged by military law.
translations.idiomatic: " Yan Temür replied, "In every battle your subject must take the lead in person; whoever dares hang back is judged by military law.

sentences.zh: 若委之諸將，萬一失利，悔將何及？

translations.literal: If it were entrusted to the generals and they should fail, what regret would there be time for?
translations.idiomatic: If it were entrusted to the generals and they should fail, what regret would there be time for?

sentences.zh: 」甲申，慶雲見。

translations.literal: " On jiashen day auspicious clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiashen day auspicious clouds appeared.

sentences.zh: 王禪單騎亡，撒敦追之不及而還。

translations.literal: Wang Chan fled alone on horseback; Sadun pursued but could not overtake him and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chan fled alone on horseback; Sadun pursued but could not overtake him and returned.

sentences.zh: 命御史臺：「凡各道廉訪司官，用蒙古二人，畏兀、河西、回回、漢人各一人。

translations.literal: The censorate was ordered: "For all surveillance commissioners in each circuit, appoint two Mongols, and one each from Uighur, Hexi, Muslim, and Han;
translations.idiomatic: The censorate was ordered: "For all surveillance commissioners in each circuit, appoint 2 Mongols, and 1 each from Uighur, Hexi, Muslim, and Han;

sentences.zh: 各司書吏十六人，用職官五，各路司吏五，教授二，鄉貢進士四人。

translations.literal: sixteen clerks in each office — five officeholders, five route clerks, two instructors, and four provincial graduates.
translations.idiomatic: 16 clerks in each office — 5 officeholders, 5 route clerks, 2 instructors, and 4 provincial graduates.

sentences.zh: 本臺經歷品秩相當者，除各道廉訪使，都事除副使。

translations.literal: Central office administrators of equivalent rank are to be appointed surveillance commissioners; office managers are to be appointed vice commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Central office administrators of equivalent rank are to be appointed surveillance commissioners; office managers are to be appointed vice commissioners.

sentences.zh: 今臺譯史通事考滿不得除御史。

translations.literal: Henceforth censorate translators and interpreters who complete their term of service may not be appointed censors.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth censorate translators and interpreters who complete their term of service may not be appointed censors.

sentences.zh: 」靖安王闊不花等將陜西兵潛由潼關南水門入，萬戶孛羅棄關走，闊不花等分據陜州等縣，縱兵四劫。

translations.literal: " Prince Jing'an Kokebuluq and others led Shaanxi troops in secretly entering through Tong Pass's southern water gate; commander of ten-thousands Bolad abandoned the pass and fled; Kokebuluq and others separately occupied Shaan Prefecture and other counties and let their troops plunder on all sides.
translations.idiomatic: " Prince Jing'an Kokebuluq and others led Shaanxi troops in secretly entering through Tong Pass's southern water gate; commander of ten-thousands Bolad abandoned the pass and fled; Kokebuluq and others separately occupied Shaan Prefecture and other counties and let their troops plunder on all sides.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以明裏董阿為中書平章政事，嶺北行省左丞燕不鄰知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Mingli Dong'a was made central secretariat grand councillor; Lingbei branch secretariat left vice chancellor Yanbulu was made privy council administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Mingli Dong'a was made central secretariat grand councillor; Lingbei branch secretariat left vice chancellor Yanbulu was made privy council administrator.

sentences.zh: 募丁壯千人守捍城郭。

translations.literal: One thousand able-bodied men were recruited to defend the walled cities.
translations.idiomatic: 1,000 able-bodied men were recruited to defend the walled cities.

sentences.zh: 上都兵入古北口，將士皆潰，其知樞密院事竹溫臺以兵掠石槽。

translations.literal: Shangdu troops entered Gubeikou Pass; officers and soldiers all fled in rout; privy council administrator Juwentai led troops to plunder Shicao.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu troops entered Gubeikou Pass; officers and soldiers all fled in rout; privy council administrator Juwentai led troops to plunder Shicao.

sentences.zh: 追封乳母完者雲國夫人，其夫斡羅思贈太保，封雲國公，謚忠懿；

translations.literal: Posthumous enfeoffment was granted to wet nurse Wanzhe as Lady of the Yun State; her husband Oros was posthumously made grand preceptor and enfeoffed Duke of the Yun State, posthumous name Zhongyi;
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous enfeoffment was granted to wet nurse Wanzhe as Lady of the Yun State; her husband Oros was posthumously made grand preceptor and enfeoffed Duke of the Yun State, posthumous name Zhongyi;

sentences.zh: 子鎖乃贈司徒，封雲國公，謚貞閔。

translations.literal: her son Sonai was posthumously made minister of works and enfeoffed Duke of the Yun State, posthumous name Zhenmin.
translations.idiomatic: her son Sonai was posthumously made minister of works and enfeoffed Duke of the Yun State, posthumous name Zhenmin.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒遣撒敦倍道趨石槽，掩其不備，擊之。

translations.literal: Yan Temür dispatched Sadun by forced march to rush to Shicao and strike them unprepared.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür dispatched Sadun by forced march to rush to Shicao and strike them unprepared.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒大兵繼至，轉戰四十餘里，至牛頭山，擒駙馬孛羅帖木兒，平章蒙古塔失、雅失帖木兒，將作院使撒兒討溫，送闕下戮之，將校降者萬人，余兵奔竄，夜遣撒敦出古北口逐之。

translations.literal: Yan Temür's main army followed; fighting continued for more than forty li to Niutou Mountain; imperial son-in-law Bolad Temür, grand councillor Mongol Tashi, Yeshi Temür, and director of the Palace Construction Office Sar Toghan were captured and sent to court for execution; commanders who surrendered numbered ten thousand, and the remaining troops fled in disorder; by night Sadun was dispatched out through Gubeikou Pass to pursue them.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür's main army followed; fighting continued for more than 40 li to Niutou Mountain; imperial son-in-law Bolad Temür, grand councillor Mongol Tashi, Yeshi Temür, and director of the Palace Construction Office Sar Toghan were captured and sent to court for execution; commanders who surrendered numbered 10,000, and the remaining troops fled in disorder; by night Sadun was dispatched out through Gubeikou Pass to pursue them.

sentences.zh: 脫脫木兒與遼東軍戰薊州南，殺獲無算。

translations.literal: Toqtoghan fought the Liaodong army south of Jizhou; the slain and captured were beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: Toqtoghan fought the Liaodong army south of Jizhou; the slain and captured were beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 調河南蒙古軍老幼五萬人，增守京師，募丁壯守直沽。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand old and young of the Henan Mongol army were mobilized to reinforce the capital's defense; able-bodied men were recruited to guard Zhigu.
translations.idiomatic: 50,000 old and young of the Henan Mongol army were mobilized to reinforce the capital's defense; able-bodied men were recruited to guard Zhigu.

sentences.zh: 調臨清萬戶府運糧軍三千五百並御河分守，山東丁壯萬人守禦益都、般陽諸處海港。

translations.literal: Three thousand five hundred transport troops of the Linqing Office of Commanders of Ten-Thousands were mobilized for divided garrison along the Imperial Canal; ten thousand able-bodied men of Shandong were ordered to defend the seaports at Yidu, Panyang, and other places.
