translations.idiomatic: 3,500 transport troops of the Linqing Office of Commanders of Ten-Thousands were mobilized for divided garrison along the Imperial Canal; 10,000 able-bodied men of Shandong were ordered to defend the seaports at Yidu, Panyang, and other places.

sentences.zh: 居庸關壘石以為固。

translations.literal: Juyong Pass was piled with stones to strengthen its defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Juyong Pass was piled with stones to strengthen its defenses.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，遼東軍抵京城，燕鐵木兒引兵拒之，令京城里長召募丁壯及百工合萬人，與兵士為伍，乘城守禦，月給鈔三錠、米三斗。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the Liaodong army reached the capital; Yan Temür led troops to resist them and ordered ward headmen in the capital to summon able-bodied men and artisans totaling ten thousand, to serve together with soldiers in garrisoning and defending the walls, each receiving three ingots of notes and three dou of grain monthly.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Liaodong army reached the capital; Yan Temür led troops to resist them and ordered ward headmen in the capital to summon able-bodied men and artisans totaling 10,000, to serve together with soldiers in garrisoning and defending the walls, each receiving 3 ingots of notes and 3 dou of grain monthly.

sentences.zh: 冀寧、晉寧兩路所轄：代州之雁門關，崞州之陽武關，嵐州之天澗口、皮庫口，保德州之寨底、天橋、白羊三關，石州之塢堡口，汾州之向陽關，隰州之烏門關，吉州之馬頭、秦王嶺二關，靈石縣之陰地關，皆令穿塹壘石以為固，調丁壯守之。

translations.literal: Under Jining and Jinning routes: Yanmen Pass in Da Prefecture, Yangwu Pass in Guo Prefecture, Tianjian and Piku passes in Lan Prefecture, Zaidi, Tianqiao, and Baiyang passes in Baode Prefecture, Wubao Pass in Shi Prefecture, Xiangyang Pass in Fen Prefecture, Wumen Pass in Xi Prefecture, Matou and Qinwangling passes in Ji Prefecture, and Yindi Pass in Lingshi County — all were ordered to dig trenches and pile stones to strengthen defenses, and able-bodied men were conscripted to garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jining and Jinning routes: Yanmen Pass in Da Prefecture, Yangwu Pass in Guo Prefecture, Tianjian and Piku passes in Lan Prefecture, Zaidi, Tianqiao, and Baiyang passes in Baode Prefecture, Wubao Pass in Shi Prefecture, Xiangyang Pass in Fen Prefecture, Wumen Pass in Xi Prefecture, Matou and Qinwangling passes in Ji Prefecture, and Yindi Pass in Lingshi County — all were ordered to dig trenches and pile stones to strengthen defenses, and able-bodied men were conscripted to garrison them.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上都諸王忽剌臺等兵入紫荊關，將士皆潰，行樞密院官卜顏、斡都蠻，指揮使也速臺兒將兵援之。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Shangdu princes Hulatai and others entered Zijing Pass; officers and troops all scattered in rout; mobile privy council officials Buyan and Ordoman, and commander Yesu Taier led troops to their relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Shangdu princes Hulatai and others entered Zijing Pass; officers and troops all scattered in rout; mobile privy council officials Buyan and Ordoman, and commander Yesu Taier led troops to their relief.

sentences.zh: 陜西行臺御史大夫也先帖木兒引兵從大慶關渡河，擒河中府官，殺之。

translations.literal: Shaanxi branch censorate censor-in-chief Yesi Temür led troops across the river from Daqing Pass, captured the officials of Hezhong Prefecture, and killed them.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi branch censorate censor-in-chief Yesi Temür led troops across the river from Daqing Pass, captured the officials of Hezhong Prefecture, and killed them.

sentences.zh: 萬戶徹裏帖木兒軍潰而遁，河南廉訪副使萬家閭言：「徹裏帖木兒身為大將，紀律不嚴，望風奔潰，宜加重罰，以示勸懲。

translations.literal: Wanhu Cheli Temür's army scattered in rout and fled; Henan surveillance vice commissioner Wan Jialu said: "Cheli Temür as a great general maintained lax discipline and fled at the sight of the enemy — he should receive severe punishment as encouragement and warning.
translations.idiomatic: Wanhu Cheli Temür's army scattered in rout and fled; Henan surveillance vice commissioner Wan Jialu said: "Cheli Temür as a great general maintained lax discipline and fled at the sight of the enemy — he should receive severe punishment as encouragement and warning.

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: " No response.
translations.idiomatic: " No response.

sentences.zh: 河東聞也先帖木兒軍至，官吏皆棄城走，也先帖木兒悉以其黨代之。

translations.literal: When Hedong learned Yesi Temür's army had arrived, officials all abandoned their cities and fled; Yesi Temür replaced them all with his partisans.
translations.idiomatic: When Hedong learned Yesi Temür's army had arrived, officials all abandoned their cities and fled; Yesi Temür replaced them all with his partisans.

sentences.zh: 召雲南行省左丞相也兒吉尼，不至。

translations.literal: Ye'erjini, left chancellor of Yunnan Branch Secretariat, was summoned but did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Ye'erjini, left chancellor of Yunnan Branch Secretariat, was summoned but did not come.

sentences.zh: 前尚書左丞相三寶奴以罪誅，其二子上都、哈剌八都兒近侍，命以所籍家貲及制命還之。

translations.literal: Former left chancellor Sanbaonu was executed for crime; his two sons Shangdu and Qala Badur served as attendants — an order restored their confiscated family property and commission edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Former left chancellor Sanbaonu was executed for crime; his two sons Shangdu and Qala Badur served as attendants — an order restored their confiscated family property and commission edicts.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑朔，命西僧作佛事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on jichou new moon, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, on jichou new moon, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒引兵至通州，擊遼東軍敗之，皆渡潞水走。

translations.literal: Yan Temür led troops to Tong Prefecture, attacked and defeated the Liaodong army, which all crossed the Lu River and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür led troops to Tong Prefecture, attacked and defeated the Liaodong army, which all crossed the Lu River and fled.

sentences.zh: 遣脫脫木兒等將兵四千，西援紫荊關。

translations.literal: Totuo Temür and others were dispatched with four thousand troops to relieve Zijing Pass from the west.
translations.idiomatic: Totuo Temür and others were dispatched with 4,000 troops to relieve Zijing Pass from the west.

sentences.zh: 調江浙兵萬人，西禦潼關。

translations.literal: Ten thousand troops from Jiang-Zhe were mobilized to defend Tong Pass from the west.
translations.idiomatic: 10,000 troops from Jiang-Zhe were mobilized to defend Tong Pass from the west.

sentences.zh: 紫荊關潰卒南走保定，因肆剽掠，同知路事阿裏沙及故平章張珪子武昌萬戶景武等率民持挺擊死數百人。

translations.literal: Routed soldiers from Zijing Pass fled south to Baoding and there plundered wantonly; associate route official Alisha and former grand councillor Zhang Gui's son Zhang Jingwu, wanhu of Wuchang, and others led the people with clubs and killed several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Routed soldiers from Zijing Pass fled south to Baoding and there plundered wantonly; associate route official Alisha and former grand councillor Zhang Gui's son Zhang Jingwu, wanhu of Wuchang, and others led the people with clubs and killed several hundred.

sentences.zh: 河南行省調兵守虎牢關。

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat mobilized troops to garrison Hulao Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat mobilized troops to garrison Hulao Pass.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，我師與遼東軍夾潞水而陣，遼東軍宵遁，我師渡而襲之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day our army and the Liaodong army drew up on opposite banks of the Lu River; the Liaodong army fled by night, and our army crossed and attacked them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day our army and the Liaodong army drew up on opposite banks of the Lu River; the Liaodong army fled by night, and our army crossed and attacked them.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，禮官言：「即位之始，當告祭郊廟、社稷，時享之禮，請改用仲月。

translations.literal: On xinmao day ritual officials said: "At the beginning of accession, sacrifices should be announced at the suburban altars and the altars of soil and grain; for seasonal offerings the rites should be changed to the second month of each season.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day ritual officials said: "At the beginning of accession, sacrifices should be announced at the suburban altars and the altars of soil and grain; for seasonal offerings the rites should be changed to the second month of each season.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 紫荊關兵進逼涿州，同知州事教化的調丁壯禦之。

translations.literal: Zijing Pass troops pressed toward Zhuo Prefecture; associate prefect Jiaohua mobilized able-bodied men to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Zijing Pass troops pressed toward Zhuo Prefecture; associate prefect Jiaohua mobilized able-bodied men to resist.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，也先捏以軍至保定，殺阿裏沙等及張景武兄弟五人，並取其家貲。

translations.literal: On renchen day Yesianier arrived at Baoding with troops, killed Alisha and others and the five brothers of the Zhang Jingwu family, and seized their family property.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Yesianier arrived at Baoding with troops, killed Alisha and others and the five brothers of the Zhang Jingwu family, and seized their family property.

sentences.zh: 倒剌沙貸其姻家長蘆鹽運司判官亦剌馬丹鈔四萬錠，買鹽營利於京師，詔追理之。

translations.literal: Doresh lent forty thousand ingots of notes to his affinal relative, vice salt transport commissioner of Changlu Salt Transport Office Yilimadan, to buy salt for profit in the capital; an edict ordered recovery and investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Doresh lent 40,000 ingots of notes to his affinal relative, vice salt transport commissioner of Changlu Salt Transport Office Yilimadan, to buy salt for profit in the capital; an edict ordered recovery and investigation.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立壽福、會福、隆禧、崇祥四總管府，分奉祖宗神御殿，秩正三品，並隸太禧院。

translations.literal: On guisi day the four chief steward offices of Shoufu, Huifu, Longxi, and Chongxiang were established to maintain the spirit halls of the ancestral emperors, all at rank 3a and subordinate to the Office of Grand Blessings.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the four chief steward offices of Shoufu, Huifu, Longxi, and Chongxiang were established to maintain the spirit halls of the ancestral emperors, all at rank 3a and subordinate to the Office of Grand Blessings.

sentences.zh: 忽剌臺遊兵進逼南城，令京城居民戶出壯丁一人，持兵仗從軍士乘城，仍於諸門列甕貯水以防火。

translations.literal: Hulatai's roaming troops pressed toward the southern city; each household in the capital was ordered to furnish one able-bodied man with weapons to join soldiers on the walls, and at each gate jars of water were placed as fire precautions.
translations.idiomatic: Hulatai's roaming troops pressed toward the southern city; each household in the capital was ordered to furnish one able-bodied man with weapons to join soldiers on the walls, and at each gate jars of water were placed as fire precautions.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒及陽翟王太平、國王朵羅臺等戰於檀子山之棗林，唐其勢陷陣，殺太平，死者蔽野，餘皆宵遁，遣撒敦追之，弗及。

translations.literal: Yan Temür, Prince of Yangzhuo Wang Taiping, Prince of Guo Duoluotai and others fought at Zaolin in Tanzizishan; Tangqishi fell in battle and killed Taiping; the dead covered the fields; the remainder all fled by night; Sadun was sent in pursuit but did not overtake them.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür, Prince of Yangzhuo Wang Taiping, Prince of Guo Duoluotai and others fought at Zaolin in Tanzizishan; Tangqishi fell in battle and killed Taiping; the dead covered the fields; the remainder all fled by night; Sadun was sent in pursuit but did not overtake them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命有司市馬千匹，賜軍士出征者。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the relevant offices were ordered to purchase one thousand horses to grant to soldiers setting out on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the relevant offices were ordered to purchase 1,000 horses to grant to soldiers setting out on campaign.

sentences.zh: 脫脫木兒、章吉與也先捏合擊敵軍於良鄉南，轉戰至瀘溝橋，忽剌臺被創，據橋而宿。

translations.literal: Totuo Temür, Zhangji, and Yesianier jointly attacked the enemy south of Liangxiang, fighting successively to the Lugou Bridge; Hulatai was wounded and encamped on the bridge for the night.
translations.idiomatic: Totuo Temür, Zhangji, and Yesianier jointly attacked the enemy south of Liangxiang, fighting successively to the Lugou Bridge; Hulatai was wounded and encamped on the bridge for the night.

sentences.zh: 乙未，燕鐵木兒率軍循北山而西，趣良鄉，諸將時與忽剌臺、阿剌帖木兒等戰於瀘溝橋，聲言燕鐵木兒大軍至，敵兵皆遁。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Yan Temür led his army west along the northern hills toward Liangxiang; generals Shi and others fought Hulatai, Alatemür and others at the Lugou Bridge, proclaiming that Yan Temür's main army had arrived — the enemy troops all fled.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Yan Temür led his army west along the northern hills toward Liangxiang; generals Shi and others fought Hulatai, Alatemür and others at the Lugou Bridge, proclaiming that Yan Temür's main army had arrived — the enemy troops all fled.

sentences.zh: 使者頒詔於甘肅，至陜西，行省、行臺官塗毀詔書，械使者送上都。

translations.literal: An envoy promulgating an edict at Gansu, upon reaching Shaanxi, had the edict defaced by branch secretariat and branch censorate officials, the envoy shackled and sent to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy promulgating an edict at Gansu, upon reaching Shaanxi, had the edict defaced by branch secretariat and branch censorate officials, the envoy shackled and sent to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 湘寧王八剌失裏引兵入冀寧，殺掠吏民。

translations.literal: Prince of Xiangning Bala Siri led troops into Jining, killing and plundering officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xiangning Bala Siri led troops into Jining, killing and plundering officials and people.

sentences.zh: 時太行諸關守備皆闕，冀寧路來告急，敕萬戶和尚將兵由故關援之。

translations.literal: At the time garrison at the Taihang passes was all deficient; Jining Route reported emergency; an edict directed wanhu Heshang to lead troops through Guyuan Pass to their relief.
translations.idiomatic: At the time garrison at the Taihang passes was all deficient; Jining Route reported emergency; an edict directed wanhu Heshang to lead troops through Guyuan Pass to their relief.

sentences.zh: 冀寧路官募民丁迎敵，和尚以兵為殿，殺獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Jining Route officials recruited civilian levies to meet the enemy; Heshang's troops formed the rear guard and killed and captured many.
translations.idiomatic: Jining Route officials recruited civilian levies to meet the enemy; Heshang's troops formed the rear guard and killed and captured many.

sentences.zh: 會上都兵大至，和尚退保故關，冀寧遂破。

translations.literal: When Shangdu troops arrived in force, Heshang withdrew to hold Guyuan Pass; Jining was thereupon overrun.
translations.idiomatic: When Shangdu troops arrived in force, Heshang withdrew to hold Guyuan Pass; Jining was thereupon overrun.

sentences.zh: 丙申，燕鐵木兒入朝，賜宴興聖殿。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Yan Temür entered court; a banquet was granted at Xingsheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Yan Temür entered court; a banquet was granted at Xingsheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 賑通州被兵之家。

translations.literal: Relief was granted to families in Tong Prefecture that had suffered warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was granted to families in Tong Prefecture that had suffered warfare.

sentences.zh: 命速速等董度支芻粟。

translations.literal: Susu and others were ordered to oversee fiscal forage and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Susu and others were ordered to oversee fiscal forage and grain.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「上都諸王、大臣，不思祖宗成憲，惑於奸臣倒剌沙之言，輒以兵犯京畿。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Shangdu princes and great ministers, heedless of the ancestral laws, deceived by the wicked minister Doresh, rashly brought troops to violate the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Shangdu princes and great ministers, heedless of the ancestral laws, deceived by the wicked minister Doresh, rashly brought troops to violate the capital region.

sentences.zh: 賴陛下洪福，王禪遂致潰亡，生擒諸王孛羅帖木兒及諸用事臣蒙古答失、雅失帖木兒等，既已明正典刑，宜傳首四方以示眾。

translations.literal: Relying on Your Majesty's great fortune, Wang Chan was thus routed; princes Boraltemür and the active ministers Mongol Dash, Yash Temür and others were captured alive; having already been duly executed according to law, their heads should be transmitted to the four directions to show the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on Your Majesty's great fortune, Wang Chan was thus routed; princes Boraltemür and the active ministers Mongol Dash, Yash Temür and others were captured alive; having already been duly executed according to law, their heads should be transmitted to the four directions to show the multitude.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以縉山縣民十人嘗為王禪向導，誅其為首者四人，余杖一百七，籍其家貲，妻子分賜守關軍士。

translations.literal: On dingyou day ten men from Jianshan County who had once guided Wang Chan were punished — the four ringleaders were executed, the rest flogged one hundred seven strokes, their family property registered for confiscation, and wives and children distributed as rewards to garrison soldiers at the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day 10 men from Jianshan County who had once guided Wang Chan were punished — the 4 ringleaders were executed, the rest flogged 107 strokes, their family property registered for confiscation, and wives and children distributed as rewards to garrison soldiers at the passes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命湖廣行省平章政事乞住調兵守歸、峽，左丞別薛守八番，以禦四川軍。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu was ordered to mobilize troops to garrison Gui and Xia; left vice chancellor Biexue was to garrison Bafan to resist Sichuan troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu was ordered to mobilize troops to garrison Gui and Xia; left vice chancellor Biexue was to garrison Bafan to resist Sichuan troops.

sentences.zh: 諸將追阿剌帖木兒等至紫荊關，獲之，送京師，皆棄市。

translations.literal: Generals pursued Alatemür and others to Zijing Pass, captured them, sent them to the capital — all were displayed and executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Generals pursued Alatemür and others to Zijing Pass, captured them, sent them to the capital — all were displayed and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸大聖壽萬安寺，謁世祖、裕宗神御殿。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Emperor visited the Dasheng Shou Wan'an Temple and paid respects at the spirit halls of Shizu and Yuzong.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Emperor visited the Dasheng Shou Wan'an Temple and paid respects at the spirit halls of Shizu and Yuzong.

sentences.zh: 賜燕鐵木兒太平王黃金印，並降制書，及賜玉盤、龍衣、珠衣、寶珠、金腰帶、海東白鶻青鶻各一。

translations.literal: Yan Temür was granted the Prince of Taiping's golden seal and an imperial commission edict, and also granted a jade dish, dragon robes, pearl robes, a pearl, a golden belt, and one each of eastern white gyrfalcon and eastern blue gyrfalcon.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür was granted the Prince of Taiping's golden seal and an imperial commission edict, and also granted a jade dish, dragon robes, pearl robes, a pearl, a golden belt, and one each of eastern white gyrfalcon and eastern blue gyrfalcon.

sentences.zh: 河南行中書省、行樞密院，皆聽便宜行事。

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat and Mobile Privy Council were both permitted to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat and Mobile Privy Council were both permitted to act at discretion.

sentences.zh: 禿滿叠兒軍復入古北口，燕鐵木兒引軍禦之，大戰於檀州南，敗之，其萬戶以兵萬人降，禿滿叠兒遂走還遼東。

translations.literal: Tumen Dayar's army again entered Gubeikou; Yan Temür led troops to resist; a great battle was fought south of Tan Prefecture; they were defeated; his wanhu surrendered with ten thousand troops; Tumen Dayar thereupon fled back to Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Tumen Dayar's army again entered Gubeikou; Yan Temür led troops to resist; a great battle was fought south of Tan Prefecture; they were defeated; his wanhu surrendered with 10,000 troops; Tumen Dayar thereupon fled back to Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 使者頒詔於陜西，行省、行臺官焚詔書，下使者獄，告於上都。

translations.literal: An envoy promulgating an edict at Shaanxi — branch secretariat and branch censorate officials burned the edict, imprisoned the envoy, and reported to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy promulgating an edict at Shaanxi — branch secretariat and branch censorate officials burned the edict, imprisoned the envoy, and reported to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以梁王王禪第賜諸王帖木兒不花。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Liang Prince Wang Chan's residence was granted to Prince Temür Buqa.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Liang Prince Wang Chan's residence was granted to Prince Temür Buqa.

sentences.zh: 廷臣言：「保定萬戶張昌，其諸父景武等既受誅，宜罷其所將兵，而奪其金虎符。

translations.literal: Court ministers said: "Baoding wanhu Zhang Chang — now that his uncles Jingwu and others have been executed, the troops he commands should be dismissed and his golden tiger tally confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Court ministers said: "Baoding wanhu Zhang Chang — now that his uncles Jingwu and others have been executed, the troops he commands should be dismissed and his golden tiger tally confiscated.

sentences.zh: 」不許。

translations.literal: " Not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: " Not permitted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以同知樞密院事脫脫木兒、通政使也不倫並知樞密院事，御史中丞亦列赤為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On xinchou day associate privy council administrator Totuo Temür and transmission commissioner Yebulun were both made privy council administrators; associate censor-in-chief Yiliechi was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day associate privy council administrator Totuo Temür and transmission commissioner Yebulun were both made privy council administrators; associate censor-in-chief Yiliechi was made censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 還給伯顏察兒、朵朵家貲。

translations.literal: Family property of Barqachar and Duodu was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Family property of Barqachar and Duodu was restored.

sentences.zh: 齊王月魯帖木兒、東路蒙古元帥不花帖木兒等以兵圍上都，倒剌沙等奉皇帝寶出降。

translations.literal: Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür and others besieged Shangdu with troops; Doresh and others presented the imperial seal and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür and others besieged Shangdu with troops; Doresh and others presented the imperial seal and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 梁王王禪遁，遼王脫脫為齊王月魯帖木兒所殺，遂收上都諸王符印。

translations.literal: Liang Prince Wang Chan fled; Liaoning Prince Tuotuo was killed by Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür; the seals of Shangdu princes were thereupon collected.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Prince Wang Chan fled; Liaoning Prince Tuotuo was killed by Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür; the seals of Shangdu princes were thereupon collected.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以宣徽使也先捏知行樞密院事，宣徽副使章吉為行樞密院副使，與知樞密院事也速臺兒等將兵西擊潼關軍。

translations.literal: On renyin day imperial provision commissioner Yesianier was made acting mobile privy council administrator; deputy imperial provision commissioner Zhangji was made deputy mobile privy council administrator; together with privy council administrator Yesu Taier and others they led troops west to attack Tong Pass troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day imperial provision commissioner Yesianier was made acting mobile privy council administrator; deputy imperial provision commissioner Zhangji was made deputy mobile privy council administrator; together with privy council administrator Yesu Taier and others they led troops west to attack Tong Pass troops.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「野理牙舊以贓罪除名，近復命為太醫使，臣等不敢奉詔。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Yeriya was once dismissed for corruption; he was recently reappointed Imperial Physician — we dare not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Yeriya was once dismissed for corruption; he was recently reappointed Imperial Physician — we dare not obey the edict.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「往者勿咎，比兵興之時，朕已錄用，其依朕命行之。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "What is past should not be blamed; when the army was raised I already recorded him for employment — let it be done according to my command.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "What is past should not be blamed; when the army was raised I already recorded him for employment — let it be done according to my command.

sentences.zh: 」以張珪女歸也先捏。

translations.literal: Zhang Gui's daughter was given in marriage to Yesianier.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gui's daughter was given in marriage to Yesianier.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以故徽政使失烈門妻賜燕鐵木兒。

translations.literal: On guimao day the wife of the late imperial provision commissioner Shiliemen was granted to Yan Temür.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the wife of the late imperial provision commissioner Shiliemen was granted to Yan Temür.

sentences.zh: 以通州知州趙義能禦敵，賜幣二匹。

translations.literal: Tong Prefecture prefect Zhao Yi, for having been able to resist the enemy, was granted two bolts of silks.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Prefecture prefect Zhao Yi, for having been able to resist the enemy, was granted 2 bolts of silks.

sentences.zh: 也先鐵木兒軍至晉寧，本路官皆遁。

translations.literal: Yesi Timür's army reached Jinning; officials of the route all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yesi Timür's army reached Jinning; officials of the route all fled.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，晉邸及遼王所轄路、府、州、縣達魯花赤並罷免禁錮，選流官代之。

translations.literal: On jiachen day darughachis of routes, prefectures, and counties under the Jin residence and Liaoning Prince were all dismissed, placed under detention, and replaced with regular appointees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day darughachis of routes, prefectures, and counties under the Jin residence and Liaoning Prince were all dismissed, placed under detention, and replaced with regular appointees.

sentences.zh: 給淮東宣慰司銀字圓符。

translations.literal: Huaidong pacification commission was granted silver-character round tally.
translations.idiomatic: Huaidong pacification commission was granted silver-character round tally.

sentences.zh: 命有司收將士所遺符印、兵仗。

translations.literal: Relevant offices were ordered to collect seals, tally tokens, and weapons abandoned by officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Relevant offices were ordered to collect seals, tally tokens, and weapons abandoned by officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 賑糶京城米十萬石，石為鈔十五貫。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand shi of rice was sold in relief in the capital at fifteen strings of notes per shi.
translations.idiomatic: 100,000 shi of rice was sold in relief in the capital at 15 strings of notes per shi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，中書省臣言：「凡有罪者，既籍其家貲，又沒其妻子，非古者罪人不孥之意，今後請勿沒人妻子。

translations.literal: On bingwu day central secretariat officials said: "When criminals are punished, after registering family property their wives and children are also confiscated — this is not the ancient meaning of not extending punishment to families; hereafter please do not confiscate men's wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day central secretariat officials said: "When criminals are punished, after registering family property their wives and children are also confiscated — this is not the ancient meaning of not extending punishment to families; hereafter please do not confiscate men's wives and children.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: " Decree approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Decree approved.

sentences.zh: 丁未，告祭於南郊。

translations.literal: On dingwei day announcement sacrifices were made at the southern suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day announcement sacrifices were made at the southern suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 以中書平章政事塔失海涯為大司農，復以欽察臺為中書平章政事，侍御史月璐不花為中丞。

translations.literal: Central secretariat grand councillor Taqaji was made grand minister of agriculture; Qincha was again made central secretariat grand councillor; attendant censor Yulubuhua was made associate censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat grand councillor Taqaji was made grand minister of agriculture; Qincha was again made central secretariat grand councillor; attendant censor Yulubuhua was made associate censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 以度支芻豆經用不足，凡諸王、駙馬來朝並節其給，宿衛官已有廩祿者及內侍宮人歲給芻豆，皆權止之。

translations.literal: Because fiscal forage and beans were insufficient for current needs, all princes and imperial sons-in-law coming to court had their provisions curtailed; guard officers who already had grain stipends and palace eunuchs and women with annual forage allotments — all were temporarily suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Because fiscal forage and beans were insufficient for current needs, all princes and imperial sons-in-law coming to court had their provisions curtailed; guard officers who already had grain stipends and palace eunuchs and women with annual forage allotments — all were temporarily suspended.

sentences.zh: 糴豆二十萬石於瀕御河州縣，以河間、山東鹽課鈔給其直。

translations.literal: Two hundred thousand shi of beans were purchased in prefectures and counties along the Imperial Canal; payment was made from salt duty notes of Hejian and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: 200,000 shi of beans were purchased in prefectures and counties along the Imperial Canal; payment was made from salt duty notes of Hejian and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 放還防河運糧軍。

translations.literal: River-defense grain-transport troops were released and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: River-defense grain-transport troops were released and sent home.

sentences.zh: 陜西兵至鞏縣黑石渡，遂據虎牢，我師皆潰，儲仗悉為所獲。

translations.literal: Shaanxi troops reached Heishi Ford in Gong County and thereupon occupied Hulao; our troops all scattered; stored weapons were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops reached Heishi Ford in Gong County and thereupon occupied Hulao; our troops all scattered; stored weapons were all captured.

sentences.zh: 河南行省來告急，戒有司修城壁，嚴守衛。

translations.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat reported emergency; an order warned relevant offices to repair walls and strengthen garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat reported emergency; an order warned relevant offices to repair walls and strengthen garrison.

sentences.zh: 雲南銀沙羅甸土官哀贊等來貢方物。

translations.literal: Yunnan Yingshaluo native official Aizan and others came to present tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Yingshaluo native official Aizan and others came to present tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 己酉，別不花加太保，落知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Biebuhua was additionally made grand guardian and removed from privy council administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Biebuhua was additionally made grand guardian and removed from privy council administrator.

sentences.zh: 命刑部郎中大都、前廣東僉事張世榮追理烏伯都剌家貲。

translations.literal: Ministry of Justice bureau director Dadu and former Guangdong associate official Zhang Shirong were ordered to pursue recovery of Ubaidullah's family property.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Justice bureau director Dadu and former Guangdong associate official Zhang Shirong were ordered to pursue recovery of Ubaidullah's family property.

sentences.zh: 開居庸關。

translations.literal: Juyong Pass was opened.
translations.idiomatic: Juyong Pass was opened.

sentences.zh: 陜西軍奪武關，萬戶楊克忠等兵潰。

translations.literal: Shaanxi troops seized Wu Pass; wanhu Yang Kezhong and others' troops scattered in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops seized Wu Pass; wanhu Yang Kezhong and others' troops scattered in rout.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝御興聖殿，齊王月魯帖木兒、諸王別思帖木兒、阿兒哈失裏、那海罕及東路蒙古元帥不花帖木兒等奉上皇帝寶。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the Emperor presided at Xingsheng Hall; Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, princes Bes Temür, Arqashiri, Nohaihan, and Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür and others presented the imperial seal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Emperor presided at Xingsheng Hall; Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, princes Bes Temür, Arqashiri, Nohaihan, and Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür and others presented the imperial seal.

sentences.zh: 倒剌沙等從至京師，下之獄，分遣使者檄行省、內郡罷兵以安百姓。

translations.literal: Doresh and others were brought to the capital and imprisoned; envoys were dispatched separately with proclamations to branch secretariat and inner prefectures to cease troops and reassure the people.
translations.idiomatic: Doresh and others were brought to the capital and imprisoned; envoys were dispatched separately with proclamations to branch secretariat and inner prefectures to cease troops and reassure the people.

sentences.zh: 以宦者伯帖木兒妻及奴婢田宅賜撒敦。

translations.literal: The wife, slaves, and fields and houses of eunuch Botemür were granted to Sadun.
translations.idiomatic: The wife, slaves, and fields and houses of eunuch Botemür were granted to Sadun.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，雲南徹裏路土官刁賽等來貢方物。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Yunnan Cheli Route native officials Diaosai and others came to present tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Yunnan Cheli Route native officials Diaosai and others came to present tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 詔：「自今朝廷政務及籍沒田宅賜人者，非與燕鐵木兒議，諸人不許奏陳。

translations.literal: An edict: "Henceforth court governance and registration and confiscation of fields and houses for grants — without deliberation with Yan Temür, no person may memorialize or petition.
translations.idiomatic: An edict: "Henceforth court governance and registration and confiscation of fields and houses for grants — without deliberation with Yan Temür, no person may memorialize or petition.

sentences.zh: 」以宦者米薛迷奴婢家貲賜伯顏。

translations.literal: The slaves and family property of eunuch Mishamini were granted to Barq.
translations.idiomatic: The slaves and family property of eunuch Mishamini were granted to Barq.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以河南、江西、湖廣入貢駕鵝太頻，令減其數以省驛傳。

translations.literal: On renzi day because Henan, Jiangxi, and Huguang tribute of imperial geese was too frequent, the number was reduced to spare relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day because Henan, Jiangxi, and Huguang tribute of imperial geese was too frequent, the number was reduced to spare relay stations.

sentences.zh: 以諸王火沙第賜燕鐵木兒繼母公主察吉兒。

translations.literal: Prince Huosha's residence was granted to Yan Temür's stepmother Princess Chagir.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Huosha's residence was granted to Yan Temür's stepmother Princess Chagir.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，燕鐵木兒辭知樞密院事，命其叔父東路蒙古元帥不花帖木兒代之。

translations.literal: On guichou day Yan Temür resigned as privy council administrator; his uncle Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür was appointed in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Yan Temür resigned as privy council administrator; his uncle Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür was appointed in his place.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒請以蒙古塔失等三十人田宅賜徹裏鐵木兒等三十人，從之。

translations.literal: Yan Temür requested that thirty persons' fields and houses including Mongol Dash be granted to thirty persons including Cheli Temür — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür requested that 30 persons' fields and houses including Mongol Dash be granted to 30 persons including Cheli Temür — approved.

sentences.zh: 以所括河北諸路馬，四百匹給四宿衛阿塔赤，二百匹給中宮阿塔赤，余二千匹分牧於內郡。

translations.literal: Of horses collected from Hebei routes, four hundred were given to the four guard corps' atachi, two hundred to the inner palace atachi, and the remaining two thousand were distributed for pasturing in inner prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Of horses collected from Hebei routes, 400 were given to the four guard corps' atachi, 200 to the inner palace atachi, and the remaining 2,000 were distributed for pasturing in inner prefectures.

sentences.zh: 核上都倉庫錢谷。

translations.literal: Shangdu storehouses' money and grain were audited.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu storehouses' money and grain were audited.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「近北兵奪紫荊關，官軍潰走，掠保定之民。

translations.literal: Censorate officials said: "Recently northern troops seized Zijing Pass; government troops scattered and fled and plundered the people of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Recently northern troops seized Zijing Pass; government troops scattered and fled and plundered the people of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 本路官與故平章張珪子景武五人，率其民擊官軍死，也先捏不俟奏聞，輒擅殺官吏及珪五子。

translations.literal: This route's officials and the five sons of former grand councillor Zhang Gui, Jingwu, led their people to attack government troops and were killed; Yesianier without awaiting memorial and report rashly killed officials on his own authority and five sons of Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: This route's officials and the five sons of former grand councillor Zhang Gui, Jingwu, led their people to attack government troops and were killed; Yesianier without awaiting memorial and report rashly killed officials on his own authority and five sons of Zhang.

sentences.zh: 珪父祖三世為國勛臣，設使珪子有罪，珪之妻女又何罪焉！

translations.literal: Zhang Gui's father and grandfather for three generations were meritorious ministers of the state — even if Zhang Gui's sons had guilt, what guilt had Zhang Gui's wife and daughters!
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gui's father and grandfather for three generations were meritorious ministers of the state — even if Zhang Gui's sons had guilt, what guilt had Zhang Gui's wife and daughters!

sentences.zh: 今既籍其家，又以其女妻也先捏，誠非國家待遇勛臣之意。

translations.literal: Now having registered their family, yet giving his daughter in marriage to Yesianier — this is truly not the state's intent in treating meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Now having registered their family, yet giving his daughter in marriage to Yesianier — this is truly not the state's intent in treating meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「卿等言是。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "What you say is correct.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "What you say is correct.

sentences.zh: 」命中書革正之。

translations.literal: " The central secretariat was ordered to rectify it.
translations.idiomatic: " The central secretariat was ordered to rectify it.

sentences.zh: 命御史臺擇人充各道廉訪司官。

translations.literal: The censorate was ordered to select men to fill surveillance posts in each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate was ordered to select men to fill surveillance posts in each circuit.

sentences.zh: 遣官賑良鄉、涿州、定興、保定驛戶之被兵者。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to grant relief to relay households in Liangxiang, Zhuo Prefecture, Dingxing, and Baoding that had suffered warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to grant relief to relay households in Liangxiang, Zhuo Prefecture, Dingxing, and Baoding that had suffered warfare.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷徽政院，改立儲慶使司，秩正二品。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Office of Imperial Provision was abolished and the Office of Stored Blessings was established, rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Office of Imperial Provision was abolished and the Office of Stored Blessings was established, rank 2a.

sentences.zh: 平章政事速速、明裏董阿並領儲慶司事，鷹坊伯撒裏、河南行省左丞姚煒並為儲慶使，元帥也速答兒執湘寧王八剌失裏送京師。

translations.literal: Grand councillors Susu and Mingli Dong'a were both put in charge of Stored Blessings Office affairs; falconry commissioner Sali and Henan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Yao Wei were both made superintendents of Stored Blessings; marshal Yesu Taier seized Prince of Xiangning Bala Siri and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councillors Susu and Mingli Dong'a were both put in charge of Stored Blessings Office affairs; falconry commissioner Sali and Henan Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Yao Wei were both made superintendents of Stored Blessings; marshal Yesu Taier seized Prince of Xiangning Bala Siri and sent him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八剌失裏及趙王馬紮罕、諸王忽剌臺，承上都之命，各起所部兵南侵冀寧，還次馬邑至是被執，其所俘男女千人，悉還其家。

translations.literal: Bala Siri, together with Prince of Zhao Mazahan and Prince Hulatai, obeying Shangdu's command, each raised their following troops to invade south into Jining; on returning and halting at Mayi they were thereupon seized; the men and women they had captured, one thousand in all, were all returned to their homes.
translations.idiomatic: Bala Siri, together with Prince of Zhao Mazahan and Prince Hulatai, obeying Shangdu's command, each raised their following troops to invade south into Jining; on returning and halting at Mayi they were thereupon seized; the men and women they had captured, 1,000 in all, were all returned to their homes.

sentences.zh: 遣使止江浙軍士之往潼關者，就還鎮。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to stop Jiang-Zhe troops going to Tong Pass, ordering them to return to their garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to stop Jiang-Zhe troops going to Tong Pass, ordering them to return to their garrisons.

sentences.zh: 也先鐵，木兒兵至潞州。

translations.literal: Yesi Temür's troops reached Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yesi Temür's troops reached Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以倒剌沙宅賜不花帖木兒，倒剌沙子潑皮宅賜斡都蠻，內侍王伯顏宅賜唐其勢。

translations.literal: On yimao day Doresh's residence was granted to Buqa Temür; Doresh's son Popi's residence was granted to Ordoman; inner attendant Wang Bayan's residence was granted to Tangqishi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Doresh's residence was granted to Buqa Temür; Doresh's son Popi's residence was granted to Ordoman; inner attendant Wang Bayan's residence was granted to Tangqishi.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，燕鐵木兒請以所沒逆臣赤斤鐵木兒家貲還其妻。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Yan Temür requested that confiscated property of the traitor Chiqin Temür be returned to his wife.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Yan Temür requested that confiscated property of the traitor Chiqin Temür be returned to his wife.

sentences.zh: 鐵木哥兵入鄧州。

translations.literal: Temürge's troops entered Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Temürge's troops entered Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，毀顯宗室，升順宗祔右穆第二室，成宗祔右穆第三室，武宗祔左昭第三室，仁宗祔左昭第四室，英宗祔右穆第四室。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the chamber of Emperor Xianzong was destroyed; Emperor Shunzong was installed in the second chamber on the right of Mu; Emperor Chengzong in the third chamber on the right of Mu; Emperor Wuzong in the third chamber on the left of Zhao; Emperor Renzong in the fourth chamber on the left of Zhao; Emperor Yingzong in the fourth chamber on the right of Mu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the chamber of Emperor Xianzong was destroyed; Emperor Shunzong was installed in the second chamber on the right of Mu; Emperor Chengzong in the third chamber on the right of Mu; Emperor Wuzong in the third chamber on the left of Zhao; Emperor Renzong in the fourth chamber on the left of Zhao; Emperor Yingzong in the fourth chamber on the right of Mu.

sentences.zh: 加命燕鐵木兒為答剌罕，仍命子孫世襲其號。

translations.literal: Yan Temür was additionally granted the title Daraqan, and his descendants were still ordered to inherit the title in perpetuity.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür was additionally granted the title Daraqan, and his descendants were still ordered to inherit the title in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒請以河南平章曲列等二十三人田宅賜西安王阿剌忒納失裏等二十三人，從之。

translations.literal: Yan Temür requested that the fields and houses of twenty-three persons including Qole of Henan be granted to twenty-three persons including Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür requested that the fields and houses of 23 persons including Qole of Henan be granted to 23 persons including Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri — approved.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔諭廷臣曰：「凡今臣僚，唯丞相燕鐵木兒、大夫伯顏許兼三職署事，余者並從簡省。

translations.literal: On wuwu day an edict instructed the court: "Among today's officials, only Grand Councillor Yan Temür and Grand Preceptor Bayan may concurrently hold three posts and manage affairs; the rest should all be simplified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict instructed the court: "Among today's officials, only Grand Councillor Yan Temür and Grand Preceptor Bayan may concurrently hold three posts and manage affairs; the rest should all be simplified.

sentences.zh: 百司事當奏者，共議以聞，或私任己意者，不許獨請。

translations.literal: Matters of the hundred offices that should be memorialized should be jointly deliberated and reported; those who privately follow their own wishes may not memorialize alone.
translations.idiomatic: Matters of the hundred offices that should be memorialized should be jointly deliberated and reported; those who privately follow their own wishes may not memorialize alone.

sentences.zh: 上都官吏，自八月二十一日以後擢用者，並追收其制。

translations.literal: Shangdu officials appointed after the twenty-first day of the eighth month — all their commissions should be revoked."
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu officials appointed after the twenty-first day of the eighth month — all their commissions should be revoked."

sentences.zh: 」敕：「天下僧道有妻者，皆令為民。

translations.literal: An edict: "Buddhist and Daoist monks throughout the realm who have wives — all are ordered to become commoners."
translations.idiomatic: An edict: "Buddhist and Daoist monks throughout the realm who have wives — all are ordered to become commoners."

sentences.zh: 」也先捏軍次順德。

translations.literal: Yesianier's army halted at Shunde.
translations.idiomatic: Yesianier's army halted at Shunde.

sentences.zh: 令廣平、大名兩路括馬。

translations.literal: Guangping and Daming routes were ordered to requisition horses.
translations.idiomatic: Guangping and Daming routes were ordered to requisition horses.

sentences.zh: 盜殺太尉不花。

translations.literal: Buqa was murdered by thieves.
translations.idiomatic: Buqa was murdered by thieves.

sentences.zh: 初，不花乘國家多事，率眾剽掠，居庸以北皆為所擾，至是盜入其家殺之。

translations.literal: Initially, Buqa, taking advantage of the realm's many troubles, led his following in plundering; all north of Juyong was disturbed by them; at this time thieves entered his home and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, Buqa, taking advantage of the realm's many troubles, led his following in plundering; all north of Juyong was disturbed by them; at this time thieves entered his home and killed him.

sentences.zh: 興和路當盜以死罪，刑部議以為：「不花不道，眾所聞知，幸遇盜殺，而本路隱其殘剽之罪，獨以盜聞，於法不當。

translations.literal: Xinghe Route treated the thieves with capital punishment; the Ministry of Justice deliberated: "Buqa was without the Way; all knew of it; fortunately meeting with thieves' murder, yet this route concealed his crimes of remnant plunder and reported only the theft — this is improper under the law."
translations.idiomatic: Xinghe Route treated the thieves with capital punishment; the Ministry of Justice deliberated: "Buqa was without the Way; all knew of it; fortunately meeting with thieves' murder, yet this route concealed his crimes of remnant plunder and reported only the theft — this is improper under the law."

sentences.zh: 」中書以聞，帝嘉其議。

translations.literal: The central secretariat reported; the Emperor commended their deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The central secretariat reported; the Emperor commended their deliberation.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，詔諭中外曰：「諸王王禪及禿滿叠兒、阿剌不花、禿堅等，兵敗而逃，有能擒獲者，授五品官；

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiwei day an edict instructed the court and countryside: "Princes Wang Chan and Tumen Dayar, Alabuqa, Tuqan, and others, defeated in battle and fled — whoever can capture them shall be granted a fifth-rank office;
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on jiwei day an edict instructed the court and countryside: "Princes Wang Chan and Tumen Dayar, Alabuqa, Tuqan, and others, defeated in battle and fled — whoever can capture them shall be granted a fifth-rank office;

sentences.zh: 同黨之人，若能去逆效順，擒王禪等來歸者，免本罪，依上授官；

translations.literal: Fellow partisans who can abandon rebellion and submit, capture Wang Chan and others and come to submit — their original guilt is remitted, and offices granted as above;
translations.idiomatic: Fellow partisans who can abandon rebellion and submit, capture Wang Chan and others and come to submit — their original guilt is remitted, and offices granted as above;

sentences.zh: 家奴獲之者，得備宿衛；

translations.literal: Household slaves who capture them may serve in the palace guard;
translations.idiomatic: Household slaves who capture them may serve in the palace guard;

sentences.zh: 敢有隱匿者，事覺，與犯人同罪。

translations.literal: Whoever dares conceal them — when the matter is discovered, guilt equal to the criminal."
translations.idiomatic: Whoever dares conceal them — when the matter is discovered, guilt equal to the criminal."

sentences.zh: 」給殿中侍御史及冀寧路印，凡內外百司印，因兵興而失者，令中書如品秩鑄給之。

translations.literal: The surveillance censor's seal and Jining Route seal were granted; as for seals of the hundred offices within and without lost due to warfare, the central secretariat was ordered to cast and grant them according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: The surveillance censor's seal and Jining Route seal were granted; as for seals of the hundred offices within and without lost due to warfare, the central secretariat was ordered to cast and grant them according to rank.

sentences.zh: 命太保伯答沙升太傅，兼宗正紥魯忽赤，總兵北邊。

translations.literal: Grand preceptor Badashah was promoted to grand tutor and concurrently made jarquchi of the Imperial Clan Court, commanding troops on the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor Badashah was promoted to grand tutor and concurrently made jarquchi of the Imperial Clan Court, commanding troops on the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「侍御史左吉非才，不當任風憲。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Supervising censor Zuoji lacks talent and should not bear the post of wind discipline."
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Supervising censor Zuoji lacks talent and should not bear the post of wind discipline."

sentences.zh: 」御史臺臣伯顏等言：「左吉，御史所薦，若既用之，又以人言而止，臺綱不能振矣。

translations.literal: Censorate officials Bayan and others said: "Zuoji was recommended by the censorate; if having already used him, one then stops on others' word, the censorate's authority cannot be upheld.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials Bayan and others said: "Zuoji was recommended by the censorate; if having already used him, one then stops on others' word, the censorate's authority cannot be upheld.

sentences.zh: 必如省臣所言，臣等乞辭避。

translations.literal: If it must be as the central secretariat officials say, we beg to resign and withdraw."
translations.idiomatic: If it must be as the central secretariat officials say, we beg to resign and withdraw."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「汝等其勿為是言。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "You all must not speak thus.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "You all must not speak thus.

sentences.zh: 左吉果不可用，省臣何不先言之。

translations.literal: If Zuoji is truly unusable, why did the central secretariat officials not speak first.
translations.idiomatic: If Zuoji is truly unusable, why did the central secretariat officials not speak first.

sentences.zh: 其令左吉仍為侍御史。

translations.literal: Let Zuoji remain supervising censor."
translations.idiomatic: Let Zuoji remain supervising censor."

sentences.zh: 」帝謂中書省臣曰：「朕在瓊州、建康時，撒迪皆從，備極艱苦，其賜鹽引六萬，俾規利以贍其家。

translations.literal: The Emperor said to central secretariat officials: "When I was at Qiong Prefecture and Jiankang, Sadi always followed and endured utmost hardship; grant him sixty thousand salt certificates so he may seek profit to support his household."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said to central secretariat officials: "When I was at Qiong Prefecture and Jiankang, Sadi always followed and endured utmost hardship; grant him 60,000 salt certificates so he may seek profit to support his household."

sentences.zh: 」命郡縣招集被兵流亡之民，貧者賑給之。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties were ordered to gather people who had fled due to warfare; the poor were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties were ordered to gather people who had fled due to warfare; the poor were granted relief.

sentences.zh: 遼東降軍，給行糧遣還。

translations.literal: Surrendered troops of Liaodong were granted marching grain and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered troops of Liaodong were granted marching grain and sent back.

sentences.zh: 京畿及四方民為兵所掠而奴於人者，令有司追理送還。

translations.literal: Commoners of the capital region and the four directions who had been plundered by troops and enslaved by others — the relevant offices were ordered to pursue investigation and send them back.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners of the capital region and the four directions who had been plundered by troops and enslaved by others — the relevant offices were ordered to pursue investigation and send them back.

sentences.zh: 山北、京東驛被兵者，賑以鈔二萬一千五百錠。

translations.literal: Relay stations in Shannbei and Jingdong that had suffered warfare were relieved with twenty-one thousand five hundred ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Relay stations in Shannbei and Jingdong that had suffered warfare were relieved with 21,500 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 放高麗宦者米薛迷、剛答裏歸田里。

translations.literal: Goryeo eunuchs Mixiemi and Ganggadali were released to return to their villages.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo eunuchs Mixiemi and Ganggadali were released to return to their villages.

sentences.zh: 庚申，中書錄用前御史臺官亦憐真、蔡文淵。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the central secretariat recorded and employed former censorate officials Elinjin and Cai Wenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the central secretariat recorded and employed former censorate officials Elinjin and Cai Wenyuan.

sentences.zh: 用江南行臺御史王琚仁言，汰近歲白身入官者。

translations.literal: Following Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor Wang Juren's memorial, recent appointees from commoner status were purged.
translations.idiomatic: Following Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor Wang Juren's memorial, recent appointees from commoner status were purged.

sentences.zh: 敕行御史臺：「凡有糾劾，必由御史臺陳奏，勿徑以封事聞。

translations.literal: The mobile censorate was ordered: "Whatever impeachments there are must be memorialized by the censorate; do not directly report by sealed memorial."
translations.idiomatic: The mobile censorate was ordered: "Whatever impeachments there are must be memorialized by the censorate; do not directly report by sealed memorial."

sentences.zh: 」命中書省追理倒剌沙及其兄馬某沙，子潑皮、木八剌沙等家貲。

translations.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to pursue recovery of Doresh and his elder brother Ma Mou's, son Popi's, Mubaraqsha's and others' family property.
translations.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to pursue recovery of Doresh and his elder brother Ma Mou's, son Popi's, Mubaraqsha's and others' family property.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，燕鐵木兒請以紐澤田宅賜欽察臺。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Yan Temür requested that Niudze's fields and houses be granted to Qincha Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Yan Temür requested that Niudze's fields and houses be granted to Qincha Tai.

sentences.zh: 也先捏兵至武安，也先鐵木兒以軍降，河東州縣聞之，盡殺其所署官吏。

translations.literal: Yesianier's troops reached Wu'an; Yesi Temür surrendered with his army; hearing this, Hedong prefectures and counties all killed the officials he had appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Yesianier's troops reached Wu'an; Yesi Temür surrendered with his army; hearing this, Hedong prefectures and counties all killed the officials he had appointed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，帝宿齋宮。

translations.literal: On guihai day the Emperor lodged at the fasting palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Emperor lodged at the fasting palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，服袞冕，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jiazi day wearing mourning robes and cap, he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day wearing mourning robes and cap, he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 陜西兵進逼汴梁，聞朝廷傳檄罷兵，乃解去。

translations.literal: Shaanxi troops pressed toward Bianliang; hearing the court's proclamation to cease troops, they thereupon dispersed and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops pressed toward Bianliang; hearing the court's proclamation to cease troops, they thereupon dispersed and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，燕鐵木兒請以烏伯都剌等三十人田宅賜斡魯思等三十人，從之。

translations.literal: On yichou day Yan Temür requested that the fields and houses of thirty persons including Ubaidullah be granted to thirty persons including Orus — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Yan Temür requested that the fields and houses of 30 persons including Ubaidullah be granted to 30 persons including Orus — approved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，伯顏兼忠翊侍衛都指揮使。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Bayan was additionally made commander-in-chief of the Loyal Support Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Bayan was additionally made commander-in-chief of the Loyal Support Guard.

sentences.zh: 庚午，復立察罕腦兒宣慰司。

translations.literal: On gengwu day the Chaghan Na'ur pacification commission was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Chaghan Na'ur pacification commission was reestablished.

sentences.zh: 命總宿衛官分簡所募勇士，非舊嘗宿衛者皆罷去。

translations.literal: Commanders of all palace guard offices were ordered to separately select from recruited braves; those who had not formerly served in the palace guard were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders of all palace guard offices were ordered to separately select from recruited braves; those who had not formerly served in the palace guard were all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 汴梁、河南等路及南陽府頻歲蝗旱，禁其境內釀酒。

translations.literal: Bianliang, Henan and other routes and Nanyang Prefecture, suffering consecutive years of locusts and drought — brewing liquor within their territories was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Bianliang, Henan and other routes and Nanyang Prefecture, suffering consecutive years of locusts and drought — brewing liquor within their territories was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 日本舶商至福建博易者，江浙行省選廉吏征其稅。

translations.literal: Japanese merchant ships trading at Fujian — Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat selected honest officials to collect their taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese merchant ships trading at Fujian — Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat selected honest officials to collect their taxes.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「今歲既罷印鈔本，來歲擬印至元鈔一百一十九萬二千錠、中統鈔四萬錠。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "This year having already ceased printing note blocks, next year it is proposed to print one million one hundred ninety-two thousand ingots of Zhiyuan notes and forty thousand ingots of Zhongtong notes."
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "This year having already ceased printing note blocks, next year it is proposed to print 1,192,000 ingots of Zhiyuan notes and 40,000 ingots of Zhongtong notes."

sentences.zh: 」監察御史言：「戶部鈔法，歲會其數，易故以新，期於流通，不出其數。

translations.literal: Investigating censor said: "The Ministry of Revenue's note law — yearly accounting of the numbers, exchanging old for new, with the aim of circulation, not exceeding the quota.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor said: "The Ministry of Revenue's note law — yearly accounting of the numbers, exchanging old for new, with the aim of circulation, not exceeding the quota.

sentences.zh: 邇者倒剌沙以上都經費不足，命有司刻板印鈔；

translations.literal: Recently Doresh, because Shangdu's expenses were insufficient, ordered the offices to carve blocks and print notes;
translations.idiomatic: Recently Doresh, because Shangdu's expenses were insufficient, ordered the offices to carve blocks and print notes;

sentences.zh: 今事既定，宜急收毀。

translations.literal: Now that affairs are settled, they should urgently be collected and destroyed."
translations.idiomatic: Now that affairs are settled, they should urgently be collected and destroyed."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 監察御史撒裏不花、鎖南八、於欽、張士弘言：「朝廷政務，賞罰為先，功罪既明，天下斯定。

translations.literal: Investigating censors Saribuhua, Suonan Ba, Yu Qin, and Zhang Shihong said: "In court governance, rewards and punishments come first; when merit and guilt are clear, all under Heaven is thereby settled.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors Saribuhua, Suonan Ba, Yu Qin, and Zhang Shihong said: "In court governance, rewards and punishments come first; when merit and guilt are clear, all under Heaven is thereby settled.

sentences.zh: 國家近年自鐵木叠兒竊位擅權，假刑賞以遂其私，綱紀始紊。

translations.literal: In recent years the state, from Temuder's usurping position and monopolizing authority, used punishments and rewards to serve his private ends — discipline first became disordered.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the state, from Temuder's usurping position and monopolizing authority, used punishments and rewards to serve his private ends — discipline first became disordered.

sentences.zh: 迨至泰定，爵賞益濫。

translations.literal: Reaching the Taiding reign, enfeoffments and rewards grew ever more excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the Taiding reign, enfeoffments and rewards grew ever more excessive.

sentences.zh: 比以兵興，用人甚急，然而賞罰不可不嚴。

translations.literal: Recently because warfare arose and employment of men was very urgent — yet rewards and punishments cannot but be strict.
translations.idiomatic: Recently because warfare arose and employment of men was very urgent — yet rewards and punishments cannot but be strict.

sentences.zh: 夫功之高下，過之重輕，皆系天下之公論。

translations.literal: The height of merit and the weight of fault all depend on the public opinion of all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The height of merit and the weight of fault all depend on the public opinion of all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 願命有司，務合公議，明示黜陟。

translations.literal: We wish the relevant offices, in accordance with public deliberation, clearly show dismissals and promotions.
translations.idiomatic: We wish the relevant offices, in accordance with public deliberation, clearly show dismissals and promotions.

sentences.zh: 功罪既明，賞罰攸當，則朝廷肅清，紀綱振舉，而天下治矣。

translations.literal: When merit and guilt are clear and rewards and punishments are appropriate, then the court is pure, discipline is restored, and all under Heaven is governed."
translations.idiomatic: When merit and guilt are clear and rewards and punishments are appropriate, then the court is pure, discipline is restored, and all under Heaven is governed."

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor commended and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor commended and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣西僧作佛事於興和新內。

translations.literal: On xinwei day western monks were dispatched to perform Buddhist rites within Xinghe's inner precinct.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day western monks were dispatched to perform Buddhist rites within Xinghe's inner precinct.

sentences.zh: 鐵木哥兵入襄陽，本路官皆遁。

translations.literal: Temürge's troops entered Xiangyang; this route's officials all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Temürge's troops entered Xiangyang; this route's officials all fled.

sentences.zh: 襄陽縣尹谷庭珪、主簿張德獨不去，西軍執使降，不屈，死之。

translations.literal: Xiangyang County magistrate Gu Tinggui and registrar Zhang De alone did not leave; western troops seized and ordered them to submit; they would not submit and were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang County magistrate Gu Tinggui and registrar Zhang De alone did not leave; western troops seized and ordered them to submit; they would not submit and were killed.

sentences.zh: 時僉樞密院事塔海擁兵南陽不救。

translations.literal: At the time associate privy council administrator Taqai held troops at Nanyang and did not rescue.
translations.idiomatic: At the time associate privy council administrator Taqai held troops at Nanyang and did not rescue.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣官告祭社稷。

translations.literal: On renshen day officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 以故平章黑驢平江田三百頃及嘉興蘆地賜西安王阿剌忒納失裏。

translations.literal: Three hundred qing of fields at Pingjiang of former grand councillor Heilü and reed lands at Jiaxing were granted to Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri.
translations.idiomatic: 300 qing of fields at Pingjiang of former grand councillor Heilü and reed lands at Jiaxing were granted to Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，八百媳婦國使者昭哀，雲南威楚路土官胒放等，九十九寨土官必也姑等，各以方物來貢。

translations.literal: On guiyou day the eight hundred wives country envoy Zhao Ai, Yunnan Weichu Route native official Nifang and others, and ninety-nine stockade native officials including Biyegu each presented local products in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the eight hundred wives country envoy Zhao Ai, Yunnan Weichu Route native official Nifang and others, and 99 stockade native officials including Biyegu each presented local products in tribute.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒言：「向者上都舉兵，諸王失剌、樞密同知阿乞剌等十人，南望宮闕鼓噪，其黨拒命逆戰，情不可恕。

translations.literal: Yan Temür said: "Formerly when Shangdu raised troops, ten persons including Prince Siri and associate privy council administrator Aqila, facing south toward the palace shouted and clamored; their faction resisted orders and fought in rebellion — the sentiment cannot be pardoned."
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür said: "Formerly when Shangdu raised troops, ten persons including Prince Siri and associate privy council administrator Aqila, facing south toward the palace shouted and clamored; their faction resisted orders and fought in rebellion — the sentiment cannot be pardoned."

sentences.zh: 」詔各杖一百七，流遠，籍其家貲。

sentences.zh: 甲戌，居泰定後雍吉剌氏於東安州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the Empress of Taiding's Onggirad clan was resettled at Dong'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Empress of Taiding's Onggirad clan was resettled at Dong'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 杭州火，命江浙行省賑被災之家。

translations.literal: Hangzhou suffered fire; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve disaster-struck households.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou suffered fire; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to relieve disaster-struck households.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜西安王阿剌忒納失裏、齊王月魯帖木兒、知樞密院事不花帖木兒金各五百兩、銀各二千五百兩、鈔各萬錠，諸王朵列帖木兒金五十兩、銀五百兩、鈔千錠，從者及軍士有差。

translations.literal: On yihai day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri, Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, and privy council administrator Buqa Temür were each granted five hundred taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, and ten thousand ingots of notes; Prince Dor Temür fifty taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and one thousand ingots of notes; followers and soldiers according to difference.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri, Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, and privy council administrator Buqa Temür were each granted 500 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 10,000 ingots of notes; Prince Dor Temür 50 taels of gold, 500 taels of silver, and 1,000 ingots of notes; followers and soldiers according to difference.

sentences.zh: 丙子，速速坐受賂，杖一百七，徙襄陽；

translations.literal: On bingzi day Susu, for accepting bribes, was flogged one hundred seven strokes and exiled to Xiangyang;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Susu, for accepting bribes, was flogged 107 strokes and exiled to Xiangyang;

sentences.zh: 以母年老，詔留之京師。

translations.literal: Because his mother was old, an edict ordered him kept at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Because his mother was old, an edict ordered him kept at the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以躬祀太廟禮成，禦大明殿，受諸王、文武百官朝賀。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the rite of personally sacrificing at the Imperial Ancestral Temple having been completed, he presided at the Hall of Great Brightness and received homage from princes and civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the rite of personally sacrificing at the Imperial Ancestral Temple having been completed, he presided at the Hall of Great Brightness and received homage from princes and civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 荊王也速也不幹遣使傳檄至襄陽，鐵木哥引兵走。

translations.literal: Prince of Jing Yesu Buqan dispatched an envoy with a proclamation to Xiangyang; Temürge led troops and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jing Yesu Buqan dispatched an envoy with a proclamation to Xiangyang; Temürge led troops and fled.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以御史中丞月璐不花為太禧使。

translations.literal: On wuyin day surveillance vice censor Yuelu Buhua was made grand superintendent of imperial blessings.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day surveillance vice censor Yuelu Buhua was made grand superintendent of imperial blessings.

sentences.zh: 監察御史撒裏不花等言：「月璐不花素稟直氣，操履端正，陛下欲振憲綱，非任斯人不可。

translations.literal: Investigating censors Saribuhua and others said: "Yuelu Buhua has always possessed upright spirit and proper conduct; if Your Majesty wishes to restore censorate authority, none but this man will suffice."
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors Saribuhua and others said: "Yuelu Buhua has always possessed upright spirit and proper conduct; if Your Majesty wishes to restore censorate authority, none but this man will suffice."

sentences.zh: 」乃復以月璐不花為中丞，兼太禧使。

translations.literal: Yuelu Buhua was thereupon again made vice censor-in-chief, concurrently grand superintendent of imperial blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelu Buhua was thereupon again made vice censor-in-chief, concurrently grand superintendent of imperial blessings.

sentences.zh: 作佛事於五臺寺。

translations.literal: Buddhist rites were performed at Wutai Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist rites were performed at Wutai Temple.

sentences.zh: 命河南、江浙兩省以兵五萬益湖廣。

translations.literal: Henan and Jiang-Zhe provinces were ordered to augment Huguang with fifty thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Henan and Jiang-Zhe provinces were ordered to augment Huguang with 50,000 troops.

sentences.zh: 己卯，中書省臣言：「內外流官年及致仕者，並依階敘授以制敕，今後不須奏聞。

translations.literal: On jimao day central secretariat officials said: "Inner and outer officials who reach retirement age should all receive commission edicts according to rank sequence; hereafter memorial need not be made."
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day central secretariat officials said: "Inner and outer officials who reach retirement age should all receive commission edicts according to rank sequence; hereafter memorial need not be made."

translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 以也先鐵木兒、烏伯都剌珠衣賜撒迪、趙世安。

translations.literal: Pearl robes of Yesi Temür and Ubaidullah were granted to Sadi and Zhao Shi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Pearl robes of Yesi Temür and Ubaidullah were granted to Sadi and Zhao Shi'an.

sentences.zh: 諸衛漢軍及州縣丁壯所給甲胄兵仗，皆令還官。

translations.literal: Han troops of the various guards and able-bodied men of prefectures and counties to whom armor and weapons had been issued — all were ordered returned to the government.
translations.idiomatic: Han troops of the various guards and able-bodied men of prefectures and counties to whom armor and weapons had been issued — all were ordered returned to the government.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣使奉迎皇兄明宗皇帝於漠北。

translations.literal: On gengchen day envoys were dispatched to respectfully welcome the imperial elder brother Emperor Mingzong from the northern desert.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day envoys were dispatched to respectfully welcome the imperial elder brother Emperor Mingzong from the northern desert.

sentences.zh: 以中政院使敬儼為中書平章政事，同知樞密院事徹裏帖木兒為中書左丞。

translations.literal: Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Jingyan was made central secretariat grand councillor; associate privy council administrator Cheli Temür was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Jingyan was made central secretariat grand councillor; associate privy council administrator Cheli Temür was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遣欽察百戶及其軍士還鎮。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Qipchaq commanders of hundreds and their soldiers were sent back to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Qipchaq commanders of hundreds and their soldiers were sent back to garrison.

sentences.zh: 以脫脫等三人妻賜闊闊出等三人，以朵臺等十一人田宅賜駙馬朵必兒等十一人。

translations.literal: The wives of Toqto and two others were granted to Kukuqu and two others; the fields and houses of eleven persons including Duotai were granted to imperial son-in-law Dobir and eleven others.
translations.idiomatic: The wives of Toqto and two others were granted to Kukuqu and two others; the fields and houses of 11 persons including Duotai were granted to imperial son-in-law Dobir and 11 others.

sentences.zh: 壬午，第三皇子寶寧易名太平訥，命大司農買住保養於其家。

translations.literal: On renyang day the third prince Baoning was renamed Taipingne; the grand minister of agriculture Maizhu was ordered to nurture him in his household.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang day the third prince Baoning was renamed Taipingne; the grand minister of agriculture Maizhu was ordered to nurture him in his household.

sentences.zh: 詔行樞密院罷兵還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the mobile privy council to cease troops and return.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the mobile privy council to cease troops and return.

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞月璐不花為中書右丞。

translations.literal: Surveillance vice censor Yuelu Buhua was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance vice censor Yuelu Buhua was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，倒剌沙伏誅，磔其屍於市，王禪亦賜死，馬某沙、紐澤、撒的迷失、也先鐵木兒等皆棄市。

translations.literal: On guimao day Doresh was executed by beheading; his corpse was dismembered and displayed in the marketplace; Wang Chan was also granted death; Ma Mou, Niudze, Sadirishi, Yesi Temür and others were all displayed and executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Doresh was executed by beheading; his corpse was dismembered and displayed in the marketplace; Wang Chan was also granted death; Ma Mou, Niudze, Sadirishi, Yesi Temür and others were all displayed and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 以所賜速速、也先捏宅改賜駙馬謹只兒及乳媼也孫真。

translations.literal: The residences granted to Susu and Yesianier were transferred and granted to imperial son-in-law Jinzhir and wet nurse Yesunjin.
translations.idiomatic: The residences granted to Susu and Yesianier were transferred and granted to imperial son-in-law Jinzhir and wet nurse Yesunjin.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命威順王寬徹不花還鎮湖廣。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Prince of Weishun Kanchi Buqa was ordered back to his garrison at Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince of Weishun Kanchi Buqa was ordered back to his garrison at Huguang.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞趙世延以老疾辭職，不許，用故中丞崔彧故事，加平章政事居前職。

translations.literal: Associate censor-in-chief Zhao Shiyan requested resignation on account of old age and illness; this was not granted; following the precedent of former associate censor-in-chief Cui Yu, he was additionally made grand councillor while retaining his prior post.
translations.idiomatic: Associate censor-in-chief Zhao Shiyan requested resignation on account of old age and illness; this was not granted; following the precedent of former associate censor-in-chief Cui Yu, he was additionally made grand councillor while retaining his prior post.

translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "The mobile Bureau of Buddhist Affairs and mobile Directorate of Waterways should be abolished.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: It was approved.

translations.literal: On bingxu day a water-and-land Buddhist assembly was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day a water-and-land Buddhist assembly was performed.

sentences.zh: 以阿魯灰帖木兒等六人在上都欲舉義，不克而死，並賜贈謚，恤其家。

translations.literal: Aruqai Temür and five others, who at Shangdu had wished to raise righteous action but failed and died, were all posthumously granted titles and posthumous names, and their families were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: Aruqai Temür and 5 others, who at Shangdu had wished to raise righteous action but failed and died, were all posthumously granted titles and posthumous names, and their families were granted relief.

translations.idiomatic: Yan Timur said: "The darughachis of prefectures and counties under the jurisdictions of the Prince of Jin and Prince of Lia and others having already been dismissed, the Imperial Clan Court jarquchi and central secretariat adjudication officials they recommended, being all their private men, should likewise be removed.

translations.literal: Zhao Shiyan and Hanlin academicians-direct Yu Ji were ordered to compose the censorate stele inscription.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shiyan and Hanlin academicians-direct Yu Ji were ordered to compose the censorate stele inscription.

sentences.zh: 遣諸衛兵各還鎮。

translations.literal: Troops of the various guards were each dispatched back to their garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Troops of the various guards were each dispatched back to their garrisons.

sentences.zh: 別不花罷。

translations.literal: Biebuqa was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Biebuqa was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 命有司追理上都官吏預借俸。

translations.literal: The relevant offices were ordered to investigate and recover advance-salary payments by Shangdu officials.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices were ordered to investigate and recover advance-salary payments by Shangdu officials.

sentences.zh: 遼王脫脫之子八都聚黨出剽掠，敕宣德府官捕之。

translations.idiomatic: Badu, son of Prince of Lia Toghto, gathered a band and went out plundering; Xuande Prefecture officials were ordered to capture him.

translations.literal: Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Nangjiatai styled himself Prince Who Pacifies the West; he made his branch left vice chancellor Tuotuo grand councillor, former Yunnan surveillance commissioner Yang Jing left vice chancellor, killed branch grand councillors including Kanchi and other officials, raised troops, and burned and cut off plank roads.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Nangjiatai styled himself Prince Who Pacifies the West; he made his branch left vice chancellor Tuotuo grand councillor, former Yunnan surveillance commissioner Yang Jing left vice chancellor, killed branch grand councillors including Kanchi and other officials, raised troops, and burned and cut off plank roads.

translations.idiomatic: Wumeng Route professor Du Yanxiao said: "Under the sage illumination of succession to the throne, the realm within the Four Seas is greatly tranquil; provincial officials should cease arms and enter court, so that harm to one region may be avoided.

translations.idiomatic: Nangjiatai, because of his reckless words misleading the multitude, flogged him with 107 blows of the staff and imprisoned him.

translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Transmission was ordered to rectify the Mongol relay stations.

sentences.zh: 諸關隘嘗毀民屋以塞者，賜民鈔，俾完之。

translations.idiomatic: At various passes where commoners' houses had once been demolished for obstruction, notes were granted to the people so they might restore them.

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Wang Chan's male and female slaves were granted to Prince of Zhennan Tiemur Buqa and Yan Timur.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以王禪弓矢賜燕鐵木兒、伯顏。

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Wang Chan's bows and arrows were granted to Yan Timur and Bayan.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒請以馬某沙等九人田宅賜燕不鄰等九人，從之。

translations.idiomatic: Yan Timur requested that the fields and residences of Mashsha and 8 others be granted to Yan Bulin and 8 others; it was approved.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor visited the Great Monastery of Great Blessing, Fortune, and Primordial Origin and paid respects at Wuzong's spirit hall.
