sentences.zh: 雲南土官普雙等來貢方物。

translations.literal: Yunnan native officials including Pushuang came to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan native officials including Pushuang came to present local products.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「也先捏將兵所至，擅殺官吏，俘掠子女貨財。

translations.literal: Censorate officials said: "Yesunie, wherever he led troops, killed officials on his own authority and captured and plundered children, women, and goods and wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Yesunie, wherever he led troops, killed officials on his own authority and captured and plundered children, women, and goods and wealth.

sentences.zh: 己亥，造皇后玉冊、玉寶。

translations.literal: On jihai day the empress's jade book and jade seal were made.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the empress's jade book and jade seal were made.

sentences.zh: 庚子，赦天下。

translations.literal: On gengzi day an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王滿禿為果王，阿馬剌臺為毅王，宗正劄魯忽赤闊闊出等十七人並賜功臣號及階官爵謚，仍命有司刻其功於碑，賜鈔恤其家。

translations.literal: Prince Mantu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guo; Amalatai was enfeoffed as Prince of Yi; Imperial Clan Court jarquchi Kuokuochu and sixteen others were all granted meritorious subject titles and ranks, official grades, titles, and posthumous names; the relevant offices were still ordered to inscribe their merit on steles, and notes were granted to relieve their families.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Mantu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guo; Amalatai was enfeoffed as Prince of Yi; Imperial Clan Court jarquchi Kuokuochu and 16 others were all granted meritorious subject titles and ranks, official grades, titles, and posthumous names; the relevant offices were still ordered to inscribe their merit on steles, and notes were granted to relieve their families.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「陜西行省、行臺官，焚棄詔書，坐罪當流，雖經赦宥，永不錄用為宜。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Shaanxi branch secretariat and branch censorate officials burned and discarded an imperial edict; by law the crime warrants exile; although they were pardoned by amnesty, it is fitting that they never be employed again.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Shaanxi branch secretariat and branch censorate officials burned and discarded an imperial edict; by law the crime warrants exile; although they were pardoned by amnesty, it is fitting that they never be employed again.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，立龍翊侍衛親軍都指揮使司，分掌欽察軍士，秩正三品；

translations.literal: On xinchou day the Dragon Wing Guard Personal Army Metropolitan Commander-in-Chief's Office was established, in charge of Kipchak troops, rank upper third grade;
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Dragon Wing Guard Personal Army Metropolitan Commander-in-Chief's Office was established, in charge of Kipchak troops, rank upper third grade;

sentences.zh: 指揮使三人，命燕鐵木兒及卜蘭奚、卯罕為之，余官悉聽燕鐵木兒選人以聞。

translations.literal: Three commanders were appointed; Yan Timur and Bolanxi and Muohan were made them; the remaining officials were all left to Yan Timur to select men and report.
translations.idiomatic: 3 commanders were appointed; Yan Timur and Bolanxi and Muohan were made them; the remaining officials were all left to Yan Timur to select men and report.

sentences.zh: 命高昌僧作佛事於寶慈殿。

translations.literal: Gaochang monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Hall of Precious Kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Gaochang monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Hall of Precious Kindness.

sentences.zh: 江南行臺御史言：「遼王脫脫，自其祖父以來，屢為叛逆，蓋因所封地大物眾，宜削王號，處其子孫遠方，而析其元封分地。

translations.literal: Jiangnan branch censor said: "Prince of Lia Toghto, from his grandfather's time onward, has repeatedly rebelled; this is because his enfeoffment is broad and his resources abundant — the princely title should be stripped, his descendants placed in distant regions, and his original fief lands divided up.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan branch censor said: "Prince of Lia Toghto, from his grandfather's time onward, has repeatedly rebelled; this is because his enfeoffment is broad and his resources abundant — the princely title should be stripped, his descendants placed in distant regions, and his original fief lands divided up.

sentences.zh: 」詔中書與勛舊大臣議其事。

translations.literal: " An edict directed the central secretariat to deliberate the matter with meritorious old ministers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the central secretariat to deliberate the matter with meritorious old ministers.

sentences.zh: 火兒忽答等十三人從湘寧王八剌失裏用兵，既伏誅，命皆籍其家貲。

translations.literal: Huo'erhuda and thirteen others followed Prince of Xiangning Balashiri in military service; after they were executed, orders were issued to confiscate all their household property.
translations.idiomatic: Huo'erhuda and 13 others followed Prince of Xiangning Balashiri in military service; after they were executed, orders were issued to confiscate all their household property.

sentences.zh: 西僧百人作佛事於徽猷閣七日。

translations.literal: One hundred Western monks performed Buddhist rites at Huiyou Pavilion for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: 100 Western monks performed Buddhist rites at Huiyou Pavilion for 7 days.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，欽察、阿速二部，依宿衛軍士例給芻豆。

translations.literal: On guimao day the Kipchak and Asud two divisions were granted fodder and grain on the same terms as palace guard soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Kipchak and Asud 2 divisions were granted fodder and grain on the same terms as palace guard soldiers.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，伯顏加太尉、開府儀同三司，與亦列赤並為御史大夫，同振臺綱，詔天下。

translations.literal: On yisi day Bayan was made grand marshal and commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies; he and Yeliechi were both made censor-in-chief, jointly to strengthen censorate authority; an edict was issued throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Bayan was made grand marshal and commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies; he and Yeliechi were both made censor-in-chief, jointly to strengthen censorate authority; an edict was issued throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 立內宰司，隸儲慶使司，秩正三品。

translations.literal: The Inner Steward Directorate was established, subordinate to the Superintendent of Stored Blessings, rank upper third grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Steward Directorate was established, subordinate to the Superintendent of Stored Blessings, rank upper third grade.

sentences.zh: 以阿伯等六人田宅賜諸王老的等六人。

translations.literal: The fields and residences of Abe and five others were granted to princes including Lao and five others.
translations.idiomatic: The fields and residences of Abe and 5 others were granted to princes including Lao and 5 others.

sentences.zh: 雲南姚州知州高明來貢方物。

translations.literal: Gao Ming, magistrate of Yao Prefecture in Yunnan, came to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Ming, magistrate of Yao Prefecture in Yunnan, came to present local products.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以潛邸所用工匠百五十人付皇子阿剌忒納答剌，立異樣局以司之，秩從六品。

translations.literal: On wushen day one hundred fifty craftsmen used by the latent residence were entrusted to Prince Alaqtenadara; a Special Works Bureau was established to administer them, rank lower fourth grade.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day 150 craftsmen used by the latent residence were entrusted to Prince Alaqtenadara; a Special Works Bureau was established to administer them, rank lower fourth grade.

sentences.zh: 加伯顏為太保，知樞密院事不花帖木兒為太尉，香山為司徒。

translations.literal: Bayan was further made grand preceptor; privy council director Buqa Temür was made grand marshal; Xiangshan was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was further made grand preceptor; privy council director Buqa Temür was made grand marshal; Xiangshan was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 己酉，開上都酒禁。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the wine prohibition at Shangdu was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the wine prohibition at Shangdu was lifted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以諸路民匠提領所合為提舉司，秩從五品。

translations.literal: On renzi day the civilian artisan chief offices of the various routes were combined into a directorship, rank lower fifth grade.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the civilian artisan chief offices of the various routes were combined into a directorship, rank lower fifth grade.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復遣治書侍御史撒迪、內侍不顏禿古思奉迎皇兄於漠北。

translations.literal: On jiayin day investigating supervising censor Sadi and inner attendant Buyan Tugusi were again dispatched to escort the imperial elder brother from the northern desert.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day investigating supervising censor Sadi and inner attendant Buyan Tugusi were again dispatched to escort the imperial elder brother from the northern desert.

sentences.zh: 西安王阿剌忒納失裏及燕鐵木兒、鐵木兒補化，請各遣人送名鷹於行在所。

translations.literal: Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri and Yan Timur and Tiemur Buqhua each requested to dispatch men to send noted hawks to the imperial whereabouts.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri and Yan Timur and Tiemur Buqhua each requested to dispatch men to send noted hawks to the imperial whereabouts.

sentences.zh: 以王禪妻金珠首飾歸中宮。

translations.literal: Wang Chan's wife's gold, pearls, and head ornaments were returned to the empress's palace.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chan's wife's gold, pearls, and head ornaments were returned to the empress's palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，升太禧院從一品，中書左丞月璐不花為太禧使。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the Grand Blessings Court was raised to lower first grade; central secretariat left vice chancellor Yuegu Buhua was made superintendent of grand blessings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Grand Blessings Court was raised to lower first grade; central secretariat left vice chancellor Yuegu Buhua was made superintendent of grand blessings.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，封西安王阿剌忒納失裏為豫王，賜南康路為食邑。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri was enfeoffed as Prince of Yu and granted Nankang Route as fief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri was enfeoffed as Prince of Yu and granted Nankang Route as fief.

sentences.zh: 徹裏鐵木兒升右丞，參知政事躍裏鐵木兒為左丞，參議省事趙世安為參知政事。

translations.literal: Chel Temür was promoted to right vice chancellor; associate administrator Yueli Temür was made left vice chancellor; secretariat deliberator Zhao Shi'an was made associate administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Chel Temür was promoted to right vice chancellor; associate administrator Yueli Temür was made left vice chancellor; secretariat deliberator Zhao Shi'an was made associate administrator.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔：「被兵郡縣免雜役，禁釀酒，弛山場河濼之禁；

translations.literal: On wuwu day an edict said: "In commanderies and counties afflicted by warfare, miscellaneous corvée is remitted, wine-brewing is forbidden, and prohibitions on mountain pastures and river marshes are relaxed;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict said: "In commanderies and counties afflicted by warfare, miscellaneous corvée is remitted, wine-brewing is forbidden, and prohibitions on mountain pastures and river marshes are relaxed;

sentences.zh: 私相假貸者，俟秋成責償。

translations.literal: Private mutual loans — repayment is to be demanded after the autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Private mutual loans — repayment is to be demanded after the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 蒙古、色目人願丁父母憂者，聽如舊制。

translations.literal: Mongols and Semu who wish to observe mourning for parents may do so according to the former system.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols and Semu who wish to observe mourning for parents may do so according to the former system.

sentences.zh: 」御史臺言：「囊加臺拒命西南，罪不可宥，所授制敕，宜從追奪。

translations.literal: " Censorate officials said: "Nangjiatai, resisting orders in the southwest, his crime cannot be pardoned; the commission edicts he was granted should be revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Nangjiatai, resisting orders in the southwest, his crime cannot be pardoned; the commission edicts he was granted should be revoked.

sentences.zh: 」中書省臣言：「令方許囊加臺等自新，則御史言宜勿行。

translations.literal: " Central secretariat officials said: "An edict has just permitted Nangjiatai and others to reform themselves — the censorate's proposal should not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "An edict has just permitted Nangjiatai and others to reform themselves — the censorate's proposal should not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 教坊司達魯花赤撒剌兒，在武宗時遙授參知政事，階中奉大夫，詔落遙授之職，而仍其舊階。

translations.literal: Directorate of Music darughachi Sali'er, during Wuzong's time remotely invested as associate administrator, rank Middle Submissive Grand Master — an edict removed the remotely invested post while retaining his former rank.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Music darughachi Sali'er, during Wuzong's time remotely invested as associate administrator, rank Middle Submissive Grand Master — an edict removed the remotely invested post while retaining his former rank.

sentences.zh: 是月，復遣使者召雲南行省左丞相也兒吉你，又不至。

translations.literal: That month, envoys were again dispatched to summon Yunnan branch secretariat left chancellor Ye'erjini, but again he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: That month, envoys were again dispatched to summon Yunnan branch secretariat left chancellor Ye'erjini, but again he did not come.

sentences.zh: 加謚唐司徒顏真卿正烈文忠公，令有司歲時致祭。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were added for Tang Minister of Works Yan Zhenqing as Duke Wenzhong of Zhenglie; the relevant offices were ordered to perform seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous honors were added for Tang Minister of Works Yan Zhenqing as Duke Wenzhong of Zhenglie; the relevant offices were ordered to perform seasonal sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 陜西自泰定二年至是歲不雨，大饑，民相食。

translations.literal: Shaanxi from the second year of Taiding until this year had no rain; great famine ensued, and the people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi from the second year of Taiding until this year had no rain; great famine ensued, and the people ate one another.

sentences.zh: 杭州、嘉興、平江、湖州、鎮江、建德、池州、太平、廣德等路水，沒民田萬四千餘頃。

translations.literal: Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Pingjiang, Huzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiande, Chizhou, Taiping, Guangde, and other routes suffered flooding; more than fourteen thousand qing of commoners' fields were inundated.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Pingjiang, Huzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiande, Chizhou, Taiping, Guangde, and other routes suffered flooding; more than 14,000 qing of commoners' fields were inundated.

sentences.zh: 河北、山東有年。

translations.literal: Hebei and Shandong had good harvests.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei and Shandong had good harvests.
